articleTitle: Deep Learning based PQD Classification using Time and Frequency Domain Features
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Maintaining a continuous and reliable electric supply is vital for modern society to function effectively. In maintaining our electrical grid, power quality disturbances(PQDs) result in damage, data loss, and financial loss. Ensuring grid resilience and reducing their impact require accurate identification. PQDs, even little ones, can have serious long-term effects. Improved methods of deep learning for detection, categorization, and prevention are made possible by deep learning, signal processing, and smart grid technologies. In order to improve fault classification, this research suggests a novel method that combines temporal and frequency information using a CNN. Findings demonstrate how well it can identify PQDs, allowing for improved PQD classification in power networks.

articleTitle: OptiANN-LR: Augmenting Diabetes Prediction Accuracy through Hyper Learning Rate Tuning in Optimized Artificial Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Diabetes, a pervasive chronic condition, presents global health challenges. We propose a novel approach to address this, optimizing Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs) through hyperparameter tuning. Our model, OptiANN-LR, achieves an exceptional 95.57% accuracy, surpassing ABP-SCGNN 93%. Success hinges on meticulous learning rate tuning, a crucial ANN hyperparameter. With the Adam optimizer, OptiANN-LR efficiently converges, and dropout layers curb overfitting, ensuring robust generalization. These enhancements promise early diabetes diagnosis and prevention. Rigorous evaluations employing k-fold cross-validation and diverse metrics affirm OptiANN-LR's reliability. Our work showcases advanced machine learning in healthcare, especially diabetes prediction, advancing data-driven approaches. This research heralds more accurate healthcare solutions, potentially benefiting millions at risk of diabetes and facilitating proactive interventions.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning and Feature Optimization-Based Approach for Early Breast Cancer Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Millions of people now have better prognoses due to early and accurate diagnosis of breast cancer. Computer-aided diagnosis, an vital component of detection, eases the burden of accurate detection on medical staff. The process of diagnosing breast cancer with computer assistance involved the utilization of different machine learning like deep learning techniques. It techniques require the high level of computing complexity due to their complex processing. This study suggests the use of feature extraction and feature optimization for the diagnosis of cancer of breast. Information was extracted by using stationary wavelet transform method in the proposed methodology. The spider-monkey optimization technique was used to extract the features. A dynamic, population-based meta-heuristic for improved feature optimization of medical images is the spider-monkey optimization function. We proposed a neural network-based classifier (NNs) for cancer identification. An accuracy of identifying breast cancer is improved by the suggested neural network-based classifier. MATLAB 2018R was used to simulate the recommended approach. The method's valuation was conducted using the CBIS-DDSM cancer image dataset. the effectiveness of the suggested method compared to other breast cancer algorithms, including CNN, Ransom-RF, SVM, and NN. The suggested algorithm and the current breast cancer algorithm are both outperformed by the outcome analysis.

articleTitle: Solar Energy with Storage Battery based Electric Vehicle Charging Station
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The objective of this article is to familiarize readers with a hybrid energy system capable of supplying power to an electric car charging station, which utilizes solar panels. The battery storage unit is a distinct yet essential component of any hybrid energy storage system. Swiftly adjusting the supply from the storage system is essential when solar electricity is susceptible to fluctuations due to changes in solar irradiation and temperature. This is due to the variability of solar electricity. Fluctuations in power can be detected when the energy is sourced from the battery energy storage system. When there are observed shifts of power, this statement remains valid. Battery storage is essential for controlling the DC bus voltage and stabilizing variations in solar power generation when electric vehicles are incorporated into a microgrid. The objective is to maintain uniform voltage levels throughout the entire system. All results are validated using the MATLAB Simulink application.

articleTitle: A Novel Triple U-Slot Microstrip Patch Antenna Design for Multiband Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: A novel triple U-slot Microstrip Patch Antenna (MPA) design is presented with the objective of establishing multiband capability in both the C and X radiation bands. The antenna that has been presented has improved performance characteristics, which makes it appropriate for a broad variety of applications in the fields of communication and radar communication. The design makes use of the strategic integration of three U-shaped slots on a tiny microstrip patch, taking use of the resonance effects of these slots in order to generate separate frequency bands. Through the use of sophisticated electromagnetic modeling tools, the geometry and size of the antenna are adjusted in order to achieve the resonance frequencies and bandwidths that are needed. One of the factors that adds to the antenna's capacity to cover several frequency bands in an effective manner is the triple U-slot arrangement. This paper presents novel triple U-slot microstrip patch antenna design and achieved an improvement in impedance matching, radiation characteristics, and overall antenna performance as a consequence of the unique combination of the microstrip patch and the U-shaped slots.

articleTitle: Voice Assisted Facial Emotion Recognition System For Blind Peoples With Tensorflow Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This research project presents the development of a novel Voice-Assisted Facial Emotion Recognition System tailored to address the unique needs of blind individuals. Leveraging the power of deep learning and the TensorFlow framework, the system employs computer vision techniques to detect and interpret facial emotions, enabling blind users to comprehend the emotional cues of those they interact with. The project encompasses data collection, preprocessing, model training, and evaluation, resulting in a robust TensorFlow model capable of real-time emotion recognition from facial images. A voice assistant integrates seamlessly into the system, offering spoken feedback to users, thus enhancing their understanding of emotional contexts during social interactions. The system prioritizes user accessibility and privacy, ensuring a user-friendly interface and adherence to data security standards. Extensive testing and user feedback are essential components of the project, allowing for continuous improvement and optimization to meet the specific needs of blind individuals. This research offers a promising solution to empower the visually impaired community by providing them with a valuable tool for enhanced social interaction and emotional understanding. Real-World Application, Emphasize the practicality and real-world applicability of the system, showcasing how it can make a meaningful impact on the daily lives of blind individuals by helping them navigate social and emotional contexts more effectively. Multimodal Interaction, Highlight the multimodal nature of the system, which combines visual facial emotion recognition with voice-based interaction to provide a comprehensive and accessible user experience.

articleTitle: Extensive Review on Influence of Additive Addition in Insulating Oil for Transformers
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Due to its significance as a functional component in power transformers (PT) and distribution transformers (DT), the dielectric liquid has been the subject of the current study. To create a new dielectric liquid that will outperform its predecessors and uphold the highest standards, dielectric research was conducted worldwide. Under this method additive addition, comparison of various testing, key properties or properties focused, various advantages and disadvantages of the research, target applications, various standards used in the methodology, any other special studies undertaken, and the analysis tool used are all included. The result of these discussions besieges the critical failure elements of the liquid dielectric with novel methods and mitigation techniques. Researchers will undoubtedly gain a wealth of knowledge from the debates offered, allowing them to examine different approaches in one location and select the best standard and methodology for their research.

articleTitle: Teaching Learning-Based Optimization for Medical IoT applications Service Placement in Fog Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Fog Computing with Medical Internet of Things (IoT) applications changes how healthcare systems manage low latency, privacy, and reliability. This research suggests using Teaching Learning-Based Optimization (TLBO) to improve fog computing service placement for Medical IoT applications. Inspired by classroom teaching and learning, TLBO guides solutions to optimal configurations through collaboration. Service placement is crucial to fog node computational resource allocation for Medical IoT healthcare services. Optimizing medical service distribution across fog nodes reduces latency, improves privacy, and boosts healthcare system reliability. Simulations indicate the TLBO algorithm’s adaptability to dynamic and resource-constrained healthcare situations. The results show that TLBO-based service placement optimizes crucial healthcare parameters, opening up new Fog Computing applications in Medical IoT.

articleTitle: PID-Based Nonlinear Sliding Mode Control For Speed Regulation in Induction Motors: A Comprehensive Survey and Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Recently, both houses and factories have been using induction motors more and more frequently. The advancement of variable speed drives is outstanding and admirable. Induction motors are becoming more and more used in a range of industries, especially those that require precise speed regulation and lightning-fast reactions, due to their longevity and minimal maintenance costs. The most important thing is to regulate speed in order to have the best torque and economy. Because of its excellent performance induction motor, the squirrel cage induction motor has found significant use in numerous fields. Steady-state errors or sluggish reaction times to changes in load are features of conventional PID controllers. This research presents a hybrid sliding mode and PID controller to optimize the performance of the control of induction motors. The PID controller is used to control the speed of the rotor, while the sliding mode controller is used to control the motor’s torque and flux.

articleTitle: Hybrid Energy System Simulation and Modelling Incorporating Wind and Solar Power
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: To produce energy sustainably and lessen the consequences of climate change, renewable energy sources like wind and solar must be integrated into the current energy infrastructure. In order to evaluate the viability and performance of a wind and solar-based hybrid energy system (WSHES), this work presents a thorough modelling and simulation assessment of the system. The suggested method offers improved energy generation and reliability by combining the intermittent nature of wind and solar energy sources. The WSHES is assessed in the study under various operating situations using simulation tools, control algorithms, and mathematical modelling. The WSHES has a great deal of potential to improve energy sustainability, lower greenhouse gas emissions, and provide a steady supply of electricity, according to the results. The results of this study can help integrate renewable energy sources more effectively.

articleTitle: Cardiovascular Health Prognosis: Machine Learning Approaches for Precise Heart Disease Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Cardiovascular diseases, including heart diseases, represent a prevalent global health concern. The prevalence of coronary heart diseases in Indian regions varies, lesser in rural areas and more in urban areas. Numerous factors contribute to the risk of developing cardiovascular diseases. Leveraging Machine Learning (ML) algorithms to discern patterns within data for predictive purposes is a burgeoning area of research. In this study, we propose a methodology to ascertain the likelihood of an individual developing heart disease using ML algorithms. Initially, datasets are employed to reduce the dimensionality of features. Subsequently, various ML algorithms are applied to the processed data. Among the models assessed, the Logistic Regression Classifier demonstrated the highest accuracy. The results obtained, including accuracy (88.16%), precision (90%), recall (81.82%), and f-measure (85.71%), signify promising outcomes for predicting heart disease development.

articleTitle: Soldiers Health Monitoring and Position Tracking System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In today’s security landscape, safeguarding the well-being of soldiers is paramount to national security. Conventional troop safety measures often rely on coordinate-based methods to track soldiers' whereabouts. However, these methods lack the ability to monitor their health status, leaving them vulnerable in situations where they may be facing medical emergencies. To address this critical gap, a novel approach has been developed that integrates wearable sensors, global positioning system (GPS) technology, and GSM communication modules. This comprehensive system provides real-time monitoring of soldiers' vital signs, including heart rate and body temperature, while simultaneously tracking their location. This project aims to monitor soldiers' bodies and continuously collect health data. This data is then transmitted wirelessly to a base station via the GSM modem. The base station monitors the soldiers' health parameters and triggers alerts when any abnormalities are detected. Additionally, the GPS module embedded in the system provides real-time location updates, enabling commanders to track the whereabouts of their troops with precision. In the event of an emergency, soldiers can activate an emergency button on the device, which immediately sends their location information to the control room, prompting a swift response from medical personnel or rescue teams.

articleTitle: Flood Image Segmentation of UAV Aerial Images using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: An essential component of image analysis is flood segmentation, which makes it possible to identify flooded areas from aerial or satellite data. Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) are acknowledged as useful instruments that offer extensive data for comprehending the extent of floods. The study uses the latest deep learning and image processing methods, concentrating on semantic image segmentation using the U-Net and DeepLabv3 architectures. A comparative analysis demonstrates the DeepLabv3 model’s impressive performance of segmentation, with a precision of 0.7242, recall of 0.8163, IOU of 0.7414, dice loss of 0.1786, and overall accuracy of 0.9216. With competitive performance, the U-Net model achieves 0.8281 precision, 0.7937 recall, 0.5266 IOU, 0.1791 Dice loss, and 0.8974 accuracy. Performance of both models are well at segmentation flooding related feature, with U-Net exhibiting almost better precision.

articleTitle: Deep CNN-Based MRI Imaging for Brain Tumor Detection and Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Depression and anxiety disorders are two psychological problems that can be significantly triggered by brain tumors. Detecting various disorders requires patients to receive assistance from healthcare image analytics. Accurate tumor identification facilitates the process of recovering from a brain tumor. Classifying the types of brain tumors is a crucial factor that relies on the doctor's competence and understanding. To assist doctors, a sophisticated method for identifying and categorizing brain tumors is required. This work is novel as it employs a deep CNN approach to classify various types of brain tumors. For a speedy and effective recovery, analysis and tumor categorization are crucial, and MRI brain image analytics via a Deep CNN is producing exceptional results in this area. The Deep CNN classifies the various tumor types and trains the data accordingly. The classification of brain tumors into four distinct primary subtypes, namely Glioma, Meningioma, Pituitary, and Healthy, has been achieved through a proposed approach. The proposed model outperforms the most recent approaches in Brain tumors were classified and categorized with an accuracy rate of 97.85%. This suggested solution holds the potential to provide valuable clinical aid to the healthcare industry.

articleTitle: Real estate price prognostication through machine learning models
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In the dynamic realm of real estate, house prices became the crucial part to encounter the set of hurdles to make lives better. Through meticulous feature engineering, which includes advanced data cleansing and feature manipulation, coupled with robust machine learning techniques, our model offers a nuanced understanding of valuation dynamics. The optimization process involves hyper parameter tuning and cross-validation, employing cutting-edge methodologies to extract latent patterns and yield meaningful insights from the underlying data. Leveraging algorithms of supervised learning algorithms like linear regression and K-fold, chosen for their ability to discern intricate patterns within diverse datasets, our research pioneers a transformative approach to real estate valuation. Evaluation metrics such as Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE), Mean Squared Error (MSE) and R-squared were used to ensure a robust and accurate predictive framework which were promising

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of a mm-Wave MIMO Antenna Array for 5G Communications
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In this paper, a MIMO-enabled antenna array topology for 5G mobile technology system is outlined. The outlined antenna is consist of four symmetric, slotted E-shaped elements which are positioned in the middle where the substrate is a Rogers RT5880 which has 0.254 mm thickness and loss tangent of 0.0009 and a value of dielectric constant is 2.2, respectively. The proposed antenna element's dimensions are 10×6×0.254 (mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>). E-shaped slots are inserted into copper atop the substrate's surface. The 37 GHz frequency range, set aside for millimeter-wave uses in 5G communication, is covered by the outlined MIMO antenna structure. With the use of CST software, the proposed antenna's return loss, VSWR, directivity are all calculated. A 1×4 array obtained a return loss of -55.658 dB at 37 GHz, while 1×2 array obtained a return loss of -47.147 dB, and a single element antenna obtained a return loss of -23.477 dB. The reflection coefficient, VSWR, and radiation pattern of the suggested MIMO structure are observed and found to be below the recognized threshold. Results from simulations indicate enhanced antenna performance at the desired frequency, which is acceptable for applications including 5G millimeter-wave technology.

articleTitle: An Isolated Inverted U-Shaped MIMO Antenna for Performance Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The antenna operates within the frequency of 8.1 to 8.5 GHz range, catering to applications demanding reliable communication in this specific spectrum. The inverted U-shaped ground stub serves as a unique isolator, contributing to improved isolation between antenna elements and mitigating interference, thereby enhancing Multiple Input Multiple Output (MIMO) system performance. The design intricacies, including geometric dimensions and positioning of the inverted U-shaped ground stub, are optimized for resonance within the specified frequency range. The antenna demonstrates promising characteristics, with a focus on enhanced isolation, reduced mutual coupling, and improved radiation efficiency. Simulations and testing validate the effectiveness of the proposed design, showcasing its potential in advanced systems of wireless communication application requiring MIMO technology.

articleTitle: Enhanced Customer Insights: Multimodal NLP Feedback System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The provision of feedback that is both effective and constructive is of critical importance in the process of enhancing the shopping mall experience for customers. It is a very useful instrument for identifying areas that might be improved and for providing insights into the level of happiness experienced by customers. There are various obstacles that might arise from the use of traditional feedback techniques, such as time limits and communication barriers. These approaches frequently involve active engagement from customers. By doing away with the requirement for face-to-face contact, the implementation of a "silent feedback system" that makes use of natural language processing techniques brings about a revolutionary change in the feedback process. Within the context of a shopping mall, this cutting-edge technology offers a streamlined and effective method for collecting vital input from customers; therefore addressing the issues that were previously remains unaddressed.Customers are able to communicate their feelings through the system by means of audio feedback, which eliminates the requirement for explicit communication in the form of written or verbal expressions. Using this model, a full analysis of the key technologies, processes, and algorithms that were utilized in the creation of the silent feedback system is provided. This model's objective is to create a complex and effective system that is able to swiftly and accurately capture the input of customers, analyze that input using natural language processing algorithms, and then provides organizations with important data as a result of this analysis. The approach that has been offered has the potential to improve businesses' decision-making processes as well as customer experience and consumer feedback systems.

articleTitle: XGBoost based Fault Detection for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Diagnosing faults is a highly complex problem in the realm of Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs). In Wireless Sensor Networks (WSN), sensor nodes are deployed in a random manner within a challenging environment, resulting in a significantly higher risk of faults occurring in these nodes compared to traditional networks. The network's functionality diminishes when the quantity of defective sensor nodes escalates within the network. The current fault detection method suffers from a high rate of false alarms and low accuracy in detecting faults, resulting in a continuous decline in network performance and quality of service. This research presents a machine learning approach using the XGBoost technique to identify problematic nodes in the sensor circuit of a network. The proposed technique is implemented using Google Colab, and its performance is assessed based on metrics such as false alarm rate, false positive rate, and accuracy. The simulation results clearly demonstrate the exceptional efficacy of the suggested method in identifying various forms of faults.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Review and Meta-Analysis of Machine Learning Applications in Screening for Diabetic Retinopathy Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The leading cause: diabetic retinopathy global blindness, affects 10% to 24% of individuals with type 1 or type 2 diabetes in primary care. Early detection using deep learning methods is critical for timely intervention and preserving vision. Our comprehensive review, including a meta-analysis, evaluates the effectiveness of these algorithms in DR detection. This study extensively assessed machine learning’s diagnostic accuracy in identifying diabetic retinopathy across diverse cases using color fundus images, aiming to pinpoint the most advanced ML strategy available. We extensively reviewed relevant literature from January 2015 to December 2022, utilizing EMBASE, PubMed, Google Scholar, and Scopus. Following PRISMA guidelines, we focused on machine learning-based study designs. Two authors independently assessed articles for inclusion based on predefined criteria, and data were collected using a standardized form. The meta-analysis reveals strong performance of machine learning in detecting diabetic retinopathy in color fundus photos, indicating readiness for clinical use. However, caution is advised due to methodological limitations in some earlier studies, such as lack of external validation and potential biases in participant selection

articleTitle: MR-TBA – An improved Trust-based Security mechanism for IoT Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: IoT has transformed healthcare by enabling remote patient monitoring, resource management, and personalized therapies. The integration of many networked devices has prompted data security and privacy concerns. This paper examines healthcare IoT security measures that protect patient data. Encryption, access control, authentication, and intrusion detection are common methods. These approaches provide significant safety, but they typically fail to address healthcare IoT’s growing threats and complex network environments. This work examines how trust-based security paradigms reduce healthcare IoT risks. Reputation systems, behavior analysis, and trust models create dynamic and adaptive security. These methods improve threat detection and response by assessing network devices and entities' trustworthiness, reducing the risk of unwanted access and data breaches. Trust-based security solutions outperform traditional security methods in resilience to sophisticated attacks and adaptability to changing threat landscapes. Results show that trust-based security models increase anomaly detection, false positive reduction, and healthcare IoT trust and integrity.

articleTitle: Homomorphic Encryption Enabled SVM for Preserving Privacy of P2P Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In recent years, the protection of our data privacy has become crucial, particularly within the realm of peer-to-peer (P2P) communication networks. we propose a novel homomorphic encryption framework a deep dive into the exploration of cutting-edge methods to ensure the preservation of privacy, placing special emphasis on the effective utilization of homomorphic encryption. Our approach strives to uphold the confidentiality of encrypted data while maintaining functionality, achieved through the integration of defensive encryption, a machine-learning classifier algorithm, and homomorphic encryption. We conduct a thorough comparative analysis both before and after incorporating homomorphic encryption. This entails the implementation of sophisticated encryption algorithms on the Support Vector Machine (SVM) model, covering diverse aspects such as data sources, transmission routes, and individual devices, using the p2p communication threats dataset. The study illuminates the inherent link between strengthening endpoint security and the adoption of homomorphic data encryption, underscoring the significance of network-level privacy controls in the realm of peer-to-peer communication. This research elevates the overall privacy architecture by harnessing Support Vector Machines (SVM) for anomaly detection and predictive analytics. In doing so, it clarifies the fundamental relationship between enhancing endpoint security and embracing homomorphic data encryption. Essentially, this work introduces novel perspectives on reinforcing privacy security within decentralized communication networks.

articleTitle: Quantum Computing: Threats & Possible Remedies
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Information Security is a buzz word today. Due to the emergence and recent developments of quantum computers, there is a possible threat on all present cryptographic methods. Researchers claim that once a powerful quantum computer comes into reality, the existing cryptosystems such as RSA, AES etc will be in trouble. So we must start developing post quantum or quantum secure cryptographic methods because changing the existing cryptosystems by quantum secure methods will be a very slow and rigorous task. So keeping this agenda in mind, in this paper, we discuss quantum computing, existing cryptosystems and possible post quantum methods in brief so that the readers of this paper can develop a clear idea about it for their future work.

articleTitle: Induced Stress Identification Using EEG: A Framework based on MVMD and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The use of EEG for stress detection has driven the development of advanced algorithms to overcome the challenge of visually analyzing subtle changes in EEG patterns. This paper introduces an automated method for identifying induced stress from EEG signals using multivariate variational mode decomposition and machine learning (ML). Various time domain features were derived from the decomposed EEG signals, leading to significant outcomes with the support vector machine classifier across three distinct scenarios of induced stress. The suggested model achieved an impressive accuracy rate of 94.3% for the stroop word-color test with a window size of 7.5 sec. Additionally, an analysis concerning different window sizes of EEG signals is also performed, offering valuable insights into various cases of induced stress and stress identification. Furthermore, a performance comparison between the proposed model and multiple ML-based classifiers demonstrated the superiority of this approach.

articleTitle: Dynamic Power Reduction in dual edge triggered D-Flip-flop clock gating using Memristor
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This work demonstrates a dual edge-triggered D-type flip-flop with a half-static clock gating circuit based on a memristor. Half static latch is coupled in parallel with two dynamic latches, and each response is according to the gated clock's positive and negative edges. This configuration improves the circuit compactness, energy efficiency and race tolerance. Cadence virtuoso (90nm GDPK library) CMOS technology is used for simulation, and the VTEAM model is used for memristor gating implementation. In this work, the transistor count is 33. Power dissipation is 8.364μw, and clock to Q delay is 150.7 ps, less than the existing design.

articleTitle: Enhancing Antenna Performance: Exploring Partially Reflective Surfaces as Superstrates
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This research introduces a compact microstrip patch antenna featuring a circular design, leveraging the coplanar waveguide port (CPW) on an FR-4 substrate. The antenna exhibits a substantial fractional bandwidth of 74.714% spanning 4.276GHz to 9.376GHz, showcasing impressive performance. At 5.776GHz, it records an exceptional return loss (S_11) of 52.4 dB, indicating high efficiency. Notably, the antenna resonates at both 5.776GHz and 7.33GHz, manifesting two distinct resonance frequencies. At 10GHz, the proposed antenna demonstrates remarkable characteristics, boasting a peak gain of 5.979.2dBi and high directivity reaching 6.62dBi. These attributes underscore its efficiency in signal reception and transmission. The antenna's compact dimensions, measuring 26x 26x1.6mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>, align with modern space-saving design requirements while delivering substantial performance. Moreover, observations highlight the antenna's bidirectional radiation field features, contributing to its versatile functionality in various applications. This research underscores the antenna's robust capabilities across a wide frequency range, emphasizing its potential for diverse wireless communication systems.

articleTitle: Gain Improvement of Patch Antenna Using Joukowsky and Schwarz-Christoffel Conformal Mapping on Feed Line Section
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This paper introduces a novel strategy involving conformal mapping on the feed line of a rectangular patch antenna. By dividing the feed line and applying various conformal mapping techniques, such as Joukowsky & Schwarz-Christoffel, the impedance matching between feed line & patch antenna is improved, & enhanced gain. The study investigates the performance of H & U-Slot antennas with & without conformal mapping on the feed line, showing how mappings enhance antennas' frequencies. The proposed design for H-Slot antenna achieves a dual mode of radiation with bandwidth of 310 MHz & 480 MHz centered at 6.1 GHz & 6.9 GHz. The U-Slot antenna with conformal mapping exhibits dual bandwidth of 380 MHz & 432 MHz centered at 3.4 GHz & 6.9 GHz. These enhancements improve the bandwidth 26.67% at 3.1 GHz & 44% at 6.9 GHz compared to antennas without conformal mapping. The gain of antennas increases with conformal mapping 976.19% improvement for U-Slot and 394.42% improvement for H-Slot at 6.9 GHz.

articleTitle: A Review on Drone-based Tracking
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This paper attempts to present a thorough review of different papers defining face recognition systems as well as autonomous tracking systems. This review will help in understanding the working of different recognition and tracking systems in dynamic environments, identifying individuals from a comprehensive database to find out the best approach. This innovative approach enhances security and surveillance, paving the way for a safer and more efficient future.

articleTitle: IOT Based Motor Control and Line Detection for Smart Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In India, agriculture is the main foundation of income for people. It has a momentous influence on the national economy. Nevertheless, there are obstacles in agriculture these days because of the relocation of society from rural to urban areas. Crop output can be increased, but not entirely by monitoring environmental factors. There aren't many things that significantly lower productivity. Therefore, automation needs to be used in farming to solve these issues. an automated irrigation system, saving the farmer money, time, then effort. Manual intervention is necessary for the irrigation of farmland using traditional methods. The amount of human intervention in irrigation can be reduced with automated equipment. Constant crop monitoring and sensing through the conjunction of sensors and the Internet of Things (IOT) to inform agriculturalists about crop growing and yield times on a regular basis, resulting in high crop productivity and accurate product delivery to customers at the appropriate time and location. Therefore, we use IOT-based smart agriculture techniques to solve this issue. In order to gather and process field data, this project has sensors for temperature, humidity, soil moisture, and rain detection. To remotely manage and monitor sensor data, these sensors are coupled with recognized web technologies in the form of a wireless sensor system.

articleTitle: Characteristics Analysis of 2-Bit Digitally Time-Coded Programmable Metasurface Using Vector Synthesis Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Digitally coded programmable metasurface (DCPM) plays a pivotal role in manipulating electromagnetic wave propagation in a desired direction. To make them programmable or reconfigurable active devices like PIN and varactor diodes are employed to acquire 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sup> number states. This paper analytically and methodologically explores the reflection characteristics of different sizes of 2-bit DCPM at their central frequency through the vector synthesis technique by altering the time-coding sequences. This time-varying coding strategy demonstrates that increasing the number of meta-atom cells or digital time-coded bits in a DCPM enhances its phase tailoring capabilities with stable amplitude in a custom-made form.

articleTitle: Online Reviews- An effective way to reduce perceived consumer risks of online shopping
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The study investigate the impact of online reviews on perceived risks of e-commerce users. Consumers constantly find ways to ease their search for best products while making online buying decision. Reviews by other consumers and product ratings serve as an important assurance mechanism for selecting unseen and untouched products of e-commerce. A number of studies have been done in the past to study the effect of online reviews on consumer decision making journey. This paper contributes in terms to literature and assessing the role of genuineness of online reviews in supporting purchase decision making. Product details, trust badges, website design are the mechanisms used by online sellers to assure consumers regarding security of data shared by online consumers. The origin of these methods is sellers and the tools used and devised by them. Hence, online reviews and product ratings are most widely used by consumers to explore all possible details about product features, specifications and prices. The information is helpful for consumers in making comparison between different propositions made by the consumers. The findings suggest strong causal relation between online reviews and perceived information security concerns of online consumers. The findings are based on the analysis of data with Smart PLS SEM method.

articleTitle: Integrated Water Quality Control and Efficient Distribution Network Management for Subterranean Pipeline
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In this paper, we unveil a transformative water quality enhancement system designed for unparalleled consistency in distribution networks. Introducing a master-slave framework, each pipeline segment is seamlessly integrated with a dedicated pumping station, equipped with state-of-the-art water quality monitoring and our groundbreaking ’sensorless flowmeter' leak detection technology. Orchestrated by a central master controller, our innovative approach ensures not only the maintenance of stringent water standards but also a swift response to potential leaks. The sensorless flowmeter, a game-changer in leak detection, delivers unprecedented precision, bolstering the reliability of the entire system. This paper presents a cutting-edge solution that redefines water infrastructure management, setting a new standard for efficiency and sustainability.

articleTitle: Modified Parametric Optimization Color Image Security Algorithm Using Latin Square Encryption Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Ensuring the security of digital images is a challenging task that requires the preservation of image properties. Image Encryption Standards (IES) are commonly employed to achieve this objective. Latin square-based encryption is particularly advantageous in the presence of significant nuisance disturbances. Typically, image encryption algorithms are constrained by key size. Therefore, the primary goal of this paper is to develop an effective Latin Square (LS)-based image encryption algorithm. We apply an updated parameter-based Latin Square encryption to the Luminance component in the LAB color space, along with the experimentally best parameter selection. The use of the LAB color space is capable of representing color information better than the RGB space, offering greater entropy and brightness. The encryption performance is assessed through parametric evaluation. The performance of the modified encryption algorithm is tested on unique color image data. The parametric evaluation is based on the Normalized Cross-Correlation Peak Ratio (NCPR), Unified Average Changing Intensity (UACI) count, and the Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) calculated over the recovered images. The efficiency of the proposed method is demonstrated through parametric evaluation, which shows an improvement over the standard method.

articleTitle: Concentric Ring-Based Multibit Chipless RFID Tag
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In this paper, a novel method is proposed to increase bit rate of concentric ring based chipless RFID tag. Three versions of concentric ring-based tags: ring type, slot type and combination of both are designed and their response in terms of number of resonant frequencies and identification (ID) bits are compared. The conventional ring type and slot type tags contain four concentric ring resonators and four slots respectively. Both conventional tags are uniplanar and produce 3 ID bits in the frequency range of 4-16 GHz. The proposed method is a combination of both conventional methods that means ring resonator on one side of substrate and complementary slots on the other side of substrate. Proposed tag produces 8 ID bits without increasing the physical size of tag. Three additional resonant frequencies are in lower frequency i.e., 2-4 GHz which makes the proposed tag compact compared to conventional tags.

articleTitle: Four Notches Microstrip Magic Tee Junction for C-Band applications
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Four notches Magic T- shape Microstrip antenna for C-Band application is presented in this paper. The Propose designing of Magic Tee junction is configured according to micro-strip structure. The Primary and auxiliary sections are designed with respect to the broad and narrow dimensions of rectangular waveguide. The Top layer of Magic tee junction design through horizontal and vertical slotting techniques. Symmetrical four T-Slots and cross configure ground plans are used in a patch for optimization of the inductance of geometry. From the simulation results achieved four notches in the C-Band where return loss ≤ -10dB, at 4.1GHz, 4.6 GHz, 4.75 GHz, and 5.65GHz. This proposed antenna is transmitting the signal through four ports at four notches. The prototypes of the design configurations were fabricated and tested. Experimental and simulation results validate the design of the proposed magic tee junction.

articleTitle: Optimal Location of Distributed Generation for Loss Minimization by Application of Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: It has been observed that DG integration has the ability to improve grid sustainability and resilience. However given the complexity of the distributed generation (DG) placement issue, a more data-driven strategy is required, especially when taking into account variables like load profiles, grid features, economic considerations, and environmental restrictions. This study contributes to enhanced grid performance in the shift toward decentralized and renewable energy sources by providing insights into the accuracy of DG placement by framing the problem as a regression challenge and assessing several machine-learning techniques. In summary, this paper highlights the potential of machine learning for recognising the change in Voltage profile and losses for improving distributed generation placement in contemporary power distribution networks.

articleTitle: Cognitive Diagnostics in Automotive using ML
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The effective diagnosis and resolution of issues in on-road and off-road vehicles are critical for maintaining optimal performance and customer satisfaction. Off-road incidents, in particular, can negatively impact brand image if not addressed promptly. Cognitive diagnostics, a novel concept, combines artificial intelligence (AI) with Unified Diagnostic Services (UDS) to create an advanced solution. This approach utilizes AI algorithms to analyze extensive vehicle data, enabling swift and accurate issue identification. By integrating machine learning into traditional diagnostic protocols, cognitive diagnostics offers benefits such as predictive maintenance, reduced downtime, and enhanced customer satisfaction. This transformative methodology not only improves issue resolution efficiency but also positively influences the overall perception of the vehicle brand.

articleTitle: Comparative study between DC-DC buck converter and Zero Voltage switching buck converter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This research compares the input power and output power between an open loop DC-DC buck converter and Zero Voltage Switching buck converter. In this paper an open loop buck converter is designed for 20V input voltage and 10V output voltage and for the same parameters and filter circuit, corresponding zero voltage switching converter is designed. Comparing the two, it can be determined how efficiently and effectively ZVS functions using soft switching method by adding capacitor across the switch to reduce the switching losses in the converter. So that, if the buck converter is being used for longer period then switching losses should not affect the overall efficiency of the converter.

articleTitle: Real-Time Multipath Fusion φ-OTDR System Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Phase-sensitive optical time domain reflectometry (φ-OTDR), renowned for its ability to demodulate the phase of interference information on sensing fibers, finds widespread application across various fields, owing to its extensive sensing distance and high sensitivity. In this paper, we introduce a realtime φ-OTDR system implemented on a Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA). This system achieves coherent fading suppression by fusing information from different polarization states. Experimental results demonstrate the system's capability to reconstruct the phase of the disturbance signal effectively, suppress signal fading, and enhance the Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) by 3dB compared to the optimized single-path system.

articleTitle: Broadband Dual-polarized Magnetoelectric Dipole Antenna for 5G Microcell Base Station
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: We introduce a broadband dual-polarized (DP) antenna designed for 5G microcell base stations wireless communications in the paper. The magnetoelectric (ME) dipole cooperates with orthogonal Г-shaped feeding lines to attain the dual-polarized characteristic. The optimized antenna impedance bandwidth is about 69 % (3.2 ~ 6.6 GHz), with the port isolation exceeding 25 dB, the peak gain is 10.3 dBi, and the radiation pattern is symmetrical. Notable advantages include wide bandwidth, simple and compact structure, low profile, and miniaturization, which make it a candidate for 5G microcell base stations antenna.

articleTitle: Comparative Study based Economic Load Dispatch in Power System using Different Metaheuristic Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Economic Load Dispatch (ELD) involves minimizing thermally generated power costs within operational constraints. While linear programming traditionally addresses this, meta-heuristic algorithms like Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), Magnetic Optimization Algorithm (MOA), and Chimp Optimization Algorithm (ChOA) show promise. This paper compares these algorithms in two case studies 3 units (coal-based, oil-based, and nuclear-based) and 6 units, evaluating their effectiveness in minimizing costs and maximizing power network load. Results highlight the efficiency of meta-heuristic approaches over traditional methods, emphasizing their potential in addressing complex engineering challenges in power systems.

articleTitle: Ultra-Wideband Horizontally Polarized Ceiling-Mount Antenna for 5G/6G Application
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In the 5G/6G communication system, antennas require ultra-wideband to enhance the signal capacity. This paper proposes an ultra-wideband horizontally polarized ceiling-mount antenna, by designing the rectangular slot as an extension slot, and loading a parasitic patch, thereby improving the impedance bandwidth. The experimental measurement demonstrates that the proposed antenna achieves 78.8% (1.73.91 GHz) of the relative bandwidth with a peak gain of 4.5 dBi and with good omnidirectional patterns in the horizontal plane.

articleTitle: Transient Stability Improvement of Multi-Machine System by using STATCOM with Power System Stabilizer
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In recent years, there has been a significant surge in power demand, while the progress in power generation and transmission has been hampered by environmental and resource limitations. Consequently, a few transmission lines have become overloaded, posing a challenge to the stability of the power system for effective power transfer. Flexible AC transmission systems (FACTS) regulators have been widely applied to address various steady-state control issues in power systems. However, recent research reveals that FACTS controllers can not only fulfill their primary role of power flow control but also contribute to enhancing power system stability. This paper presents the analysis of PSS with STATCOM to stabilize the power system.

articleTitle: Unlocking Power Transformer Reliability: DGA in Mineral Oil and Natural Esters
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The crucial factor in ensuring the reliability of any power transformer lies in thoroughly examining the analysis of dissolved gases (DG). However, there have been instances where the DG of the insulating oil alone has not been sufficient to assess its suitability. This study focuses on a posteriority analysis of the DG for both Mineral Oil (MO) and Natural Ester (NE). The DG analysis (DGA) results of MO and Natural Esters are compared based on the standards outlined in ASTM D3612-02. Key gases, grouped as group 1 (H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, CO, and CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>) and group 2 (CH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>, C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>, C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf>, and C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>), are examined in terms of their retention time to determine the oil's suitability under actual transformer conditions. By segregating and interpreting the data of these Key Gases (KG) groups, a comprehensive understanding of their impact is gained, contributing to a deeper comprehension of the subject - UNDERSTANDING KEY GASES. Throughout the analysis, it is observed that the sum of key gases in both MO and natural esters remains below 1000 ppm, which is the safe limit for combustion. Consequently, the significance of this analysis underscores the importance of monitoring key gas proportions in insulating fluids to ensure transformer safety and performance.

articleTitle: Efficiency of dye-sensitized solar cells is impacted by the incorporation of a light-scattering layer
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The study examines the effectiveness of 500 nm TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> layers in Dye-sensitized solar cells (DSSCs) to improve light absorption. By integrating these larger-particle TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> layers as scattering elements, the research aims to enhance solar cell efficiency. Comparative analysis between standard 20 nm and 500 nm TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> particles reveals promising results. The DSSC employing the 500 nm TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> paste within a hybrid-structured thin film exhibits a significant efficiency boost, reaching 4.22% to 4.59%. This highlights the substantial impact of larger-particle TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> layers in enhancing light-harvesting efficiency within DSSCs, showcasing their potential for advancing solar energy conversion technology.

articleTitle: Analyzing Emotional Responses to Audio-Visual Stimuli through Heart Rate Variability Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This study explores the utility of Heart Rate Variability (HRV) in discerning emotional responses to audiovisual stimuli. The conventional method for emotional state recognition involves Electroencephalography (EEG); however, the tedious nature of EEG signal acquisition has prompted the investigation into the more accessible Electrocardiography (ECG) and its potential to yield convenient results using HRV parameters. While HRV has shown associations with emotional processing, this research addresses HRV-based emotional state recognition—specifically, how audio-visual stimuli impact physiological stress levels, using different time domain, frequency domain, and non-linear parameters. Three genres of video – suspense, nature, and comedy videos were used. Results reveal that HRV can characterize individual responses to emotional content, and individual responses can vary significantly. Results the potential of HRV as a reliable tool for assessing emotional responses in varied contexts.

articleTitle: A Real Time implementation of PF Enhanced Two-Stage Battery Charging Solution for Battery Powered Automobiles
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This Paper presents a cascaded PF enhanced interleaved Cuk-flyback converter based two stage battery charging solution for battery powered automobiles. The interleaved /parallel configuration boons the system with lower electrical stress due to current division. The usage of flyback garnishes the battery charger with physical isolation between load and supply terminal. The model for battery powered automobiles is developed in MATLAB as well as RT Lab software and the simulated and real time results are analyzed and discussed to verify the performance of the presented system.

articleTitle: Object Detection approach for Crop and Weed Identification based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Weeds are unwanted plants in agriculture that compete with crops for nutrients, water, and space, resulting in reduced crop production. Farmers often use pesticides to control weeds, but some pesticides may remain on the crops and pose risks to human health. This paper outlines the training and evaluation of the YOLOv8 model on a dedicated dataset for crop and weed detection. Extensive tests were conducted to assess the model’s performance, utilizing the NVIDIA Tesla T4 GPU and the Google Colab cloud environment. The results indicate that the model demonstrates resilience in accurately detecting and localizing crops and weeds, achieving a mean average accuracy (mAP) of 89.7%. The small but noticeable improvements over YOLOv7 that YOLOv8 showed made it an appealing option for agricultural applications. The model’s ability to recognize crops and weeds is highlighted by the attained mAP, and this research may have ramifications for precision agriculture and weed control methods.

articleTitle: A diligent survey of SQL injection attacks, detection and evaluation of mitigation techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Today cyber security is a vast and most influenceable part of system security. This research provides detailed study of Sql injection and its various types. Research also focuses on accomplishment of attack by execution of malicious lines of code to alter SQL database. furthermore research focuses on evaluation of prevention techniques and SQL injection detection methods. For this various literatures are studied and comparative study is mention in the result section as classical SQLi, Advanced SQLi and deep learning. The research paper aims prevalent cybersecurity threat targeting databases through malicious SQL code injection. It investigates the techniques used in perpetrating SQL injection attacks, their impact on systems, and comprehensive strategies to prevent such vulnerabilities.

articleTitle: A Neural Network Architecture for Obtaining Numerical Solutions of Integral Equation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This work proposes a neural network based approach using Gated Recurrent Unit neural network to solve integral equations. The proposed method employs Monte Carlo method to discretize the integral equations into a set of linear algebraic equations followed by a neural network based method to obtain numerical solutions. We demonstrate the versatility of our proposed systems using a numerical example of the second kind of Fredholm Integral equations. Adaptive moment estimation (ADAM) optimization has been used in the neural network to find the convergence. Clear illustrations with the use of loss function graphs, solution curve pertaining to actual and predicted function values are provided to help understand the behaviour of the solutions.

articleTitle: Smart AgriSense: Precision Farming for Enhanced Crop
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Industry 4.0 has seen a massive boom in technical advancement in every sector of society like transportation, digitalization, automation in various sections, robotics, communication. In one of its domain we had came up with various developments and innovations for the benefit of the agriculture domain across the globe. IoT has played a crucial role reducing crop losses and enhancing the yield. However, rural farmers are unable to get access to these advancements because of the higher rates of the machines available in the market. So,we have come up with a very astonishing, innovative and much cheaper prototype model to help the farming sector, thereby increasing the yield of crops by 18-22% every year. Our model gives accurate and precise data from various locations in a farm that covers large acres or hectares of land and uses long-range communication for the interaction between master and slave nodes which is independent of internet connectivity. The greater impact of this model is the low cost, high reliability and ease of use for the farmers. Also, by the time, the data that will be collected can help the various machine learning models to predict the conditions of the soil for the type of cropping needed in the near future. Finally, based on thorough study and research we identified and developed this much cheaper system for smart agriculture that can solve various challenges in the farming sector.

articleTitle: Segmentation of Tuberculosis-Affected Lungs from Chest X-Ray Images using Fine-Tuned Transfer Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Lung disease is one of the largest contagious diseases which is the main cause of death in children and adults across the world. Lung disease can degrade the breathing ability and pulmonary functionality of the lungs. Viral, bacterial or fungal infections cause these diseases. The objective of this study is to introduce a modified version of the deep learning segmentation model which supports a smaller number of datasets and compares its evaluation parameters with the conventional deep learning model. It shows that the classification of lung X-ray images followed by segmentation improves the model accuracy. In the proposed model, first, we trained U-Net model for the segmentation of lungs on a chest X-ray dataset of Covid disease and saved this model. Then took this model and with the help of a transfer learning approach, we trained this model on a limited tuberculosis dataset. As a result, the proposed model helps to improve accuracy from 68.32% to 94.8% for TB. Other parameters such as dice coefficient, IoU and loss have also been improved in the proposed model.

articleTitle: An Approach to avoid SSS problem in the data space using Fisher Face(PCA+LDA ) technique: A Case Study on Chest X-ray Pneumonia data
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Pneumonia is a complex disease with a multitude of factors influencing its development and progression. Analysing Pneumonia data can be challenging due to the high dimensionality and noise present in the data. This study presents a methodology for identifying hidden patterns in chest X-ray images of pneumonia patients using Fisher face technique, which uses both principal component analysis (PCA) and linear discriminant analysis (LDA) i.e pca+lda technique (Fisher face technique), as well as the Random Forest algorithm. The SSS (small sample size) problem is a well-known issue that can arise when using LDA (Linear Discriminant Analysis) for data analysis. This problem occurs when the number of variables (features) in the data is larger than the number of samples, leading to a situation where the covariance matrix cannot be estimated reliably PCA is used to reduce the dimensionality of the chest X-ray images by identifying the most relevant features, while LDA is used to further enhance the separation between classes. The Random Forest classification algorithm is then used to classify the chest X-ray images based on the extracted features.

articleTitle: Dual Active Bridge Converter's inherent soft switching Steady-State Analysis with Single and Dual Phase Shift Modulation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Dual (DAB) active bridge converter design has received a lot of attention lately as a power conditioning device, particularly for DC microgrids and EV charging infrastructure. This is primarily because DAB offers isolated DC-DC power conversion and bidirectional (BDC) power flow capabilities, two additional advantages over conventional converters. Any application using a DAB converter must have a thorough grasp of state-of-the-art modulation methods in order to regulate power flow. This article provides an example of a steady-state converter analysis for both dual-phase shift (DPS) and singlephase shift (SPS) modulation methods. Both mathematical and graphical representations of the phase displacement/shift patterns and their relationship to various electrical factors are provided. Results of close-loop simulations for both approaches are shown for a 8 kW system operating in boost mode at 1000 V/400 V. Every voltage and current waveform that was shown had a character that matched the findings found in earlier research.

Author Keywords: Dual active bridge (DAB). Single phase shift (SPS)

articleTitle: A Broadband Dual-polarized Micro Base Station Antenna for 2/3/4/5G
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In the paper, a broadband dual-polarized antenna suitable for micro base station is introduced which covers 2/3/4/5G frequency bands. The antenna includes four rectangular radiators, two crossed Y-shaped feeders, a mental reflector and four nylon support columns. By introducing L-shaped and rectangular slots in each radiator, the bandwidth is broadened to meet the needs of broadband characteristics. The bandwidth of the antenna reaches 64.1% (1.42 - 2.76 GHz), and the isolation between two ports is greater than -30dB. In the 2/3/4G frequency bands (1.71 - 2.69 GHz), the antenna gain is 8.5 ± 1.2dBi, and in the L-band (1.427 - 1.518 GHz), the antenna gain is also achieved above 6dBi, which proves the antenna has excellent performance so that can be applied to 2G, 3G, 4G and 5G micro base station applications.

articleTitle: A Secure Signature Verification Mechanism for Smooth Authentication Process
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Authentication is very important for information security. The importance increases when it comes to financial transactions. In banking scenarios, the signatures on cheques and other instruments, are verified by banking officials manually for user authentication. It leads to a high error probability. There should be a method that can verify signatures with high efficiency but at the same time, the method must be easy to implement and have enough feasibility. Keeping this in mind, in this paper, a simple and efficient signature verification method is presented. The method can compare between two input signatures and produce the output. The output is based on the threshold value and the output can be positive (both signatures are matched) or negative (both signatures do not match).

articleTitle: Graphene Nanoribbon-Based Zigzag Simulated Output of a Gas Sensor
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This study aims to replicate the output properties of gas sensor transistors utilizing graphene nanoribbons through simulation. Among the three gases, ZZGNR exhibited the maximum ∆Q (-0.104 e), the lowest D (2.88 Å), and the highest adsorption energy (-0.273 eV) for nitric oxide. Additionally, DOS measurements revealed a significant increase in density at the Fermi level, indicating improvements in ZZGNR conductivity induced by gas adsorption. To enhance ZZGNR’s adsorption capability, the surface was modified with an epoxy group (-O-), a hydroxyl group (-OH), and both (-O-) and (-OH) groups. Consequently, this work aims to explore the relationship between ON and OFF current and channel length.

articleTitle: Wind Speed Measurement Based On Atmospheric Stability Function
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Based on the analysis of data from the wind tower in Zhang Bei County, Zhangjiakou City, the paper discusses a method with adopting a formula based on atmospheric stability. The formula is divided into two cases: stable case and unstable case, and can be successfully performed and obtained a small error, which proves the feasibility and convenience of this formula for applying to wind speed measurement in practical wind farms.

articleTitle: Tracing the transition of Insulating Oil application in Transformers
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This study undertakes a comprehensive investigation to explore strategies for replacing current dielectric liquid understanding in transformers. Understanding existing literature fosters creativity and effective research responses. The review process incorporates data and text analysis. Statistical data from 1978 to 2022 is used to understand prevailing techniques, drawn from an analysis of 80+ research publications. Contributions include Ageing 34 %, blending 20 %, additive addition 17 %, modification 8 %, gas analysis 5 %, critical dielectric testing 5 %, case studies 2 %, and others 8 %. The discussion includes 16 exclusive review papers, highlighting contributions to mixed dielectrics, nanofluids, testing manuals, modifications, and alternative fluids. This advanced study integrates materials, techniques, and standards to explore dielectric liquids, supported by accessible research journal data. The paper provides crucial data for future research.

articleTitle: Raspberry Pi-powered door lock with facial recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Facial recognition is a widely-used process that aims to detect and verify an individual's identity. This technique is employed in various applications, such as image and video analysis, surveillance, and security systems. OpenCV is a computer vision technique that enables users to comprehend the storage, modification and feature extraction of images and videos. The advancement of artificial intelligence is heavily reliant on computer vision techniques, particularly in self-driving cars, robotics, and image-editing software. The OpenCV Library is a valuable tool for processing and displaying camera images. This research utilizes the Haar Cascade Classifier, a machine learning-based algorithm, to process a user's face image and detect faces accurately.

articleTitle: Smart Shopping Cart Using Radio Frequency Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The "Smart Shopping Cart Using Radio Frequency Identification" project revolutionizes the shopping experience through RFID technology, offering real-time cost updates to shoppers. This innovative system incorporates RFID readers, a microcontroller for instant cost computations, and an LCD screen for displaying the total expense. By tackling common issues associated with traditional shopping carts, like prolonged checkout procedures and the absence of live cost monitoring, our project significantly enhances the efficiency and convenience of shopping. Shoppers can now enjoy a seamless experience as the RFID technology effortlessly scans tagged products, allowing the microcontroller to promptly calculate the overall cost, which is then displayed on the LCD screen. This breakthrough not only streamlines the shopping process but also eliminates the need for manual price entries, reducing errors and enhancing overall customer satisfaction. The successful integration of these technologies marks a promising step towards the future of retail, where smart shopping carts pave the way for quicker, more accurate, and enjoyable shopping ventures.

articleTitle: Non Isolated quadratic input stage high gain dcdc converter with reduced voltage stress in DCM
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In this work, a quadratic input stage combined with a two-inductor boost converter, a voltage multiplier cell, and switched capacitor cells are used to investigate a non-isolated dc-dc boost converter. Analysis and design of converters using discontinuous conduction mode (DCM) are discussed. With less voltage stress on the switches and diodes, the suggested converter generates a large gain without the need of any transformers or connected inductors. Along with other significant parameters and their operational principles, the study offers an explanation and a set of voltage gain formulae. The suggested converter is modeled using Matlab Simulink software with an input voltage of 30 volts and a switching frequency of 100 kHz at a 30% duty cycle in order to confirm theoretical results.

articleTitle: Skin Lesion Classification using Deep Feature Fusion and Selection Using XGBoost Classifier
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Skin cancer is a potentially fatal condition that needs to be detected as soon as possible in order to be treated effectively. Deep convolutional neural networks (DCNNs) have shown promising results in the prediction of skin cancer in recent years. This study presents a novel approach for skin cancer identification using deep feature fusion and selection based on the significance score obtained with the XGBoost classifier. The proposed method combines features from the state-of-the-art pre-trained DCNNs, such as EfficientNetB3, ResNet50, VGG16, ConvNeXtTiny, and DenseNet121, to extract high-level features from dermoscopic images. These features capture the intricate patterns and textures associated with malignant and benign skin cancers. Based on the relevance score that the XGBoost classifier awarded to each feature, the K-Best (K=1000) features were chosen. Using the XGBoost classifier, the suggested technique has successfully classified dermoscopic pictures of benign and malignant melanoma, yielding an area under the curve value of 0.95. In comparison to stand-alone DCNN-based techniques, the experimental findings show that the suggested feature fusion and selection strategy has obtained greater accuracy. Additionally, an analysis has been done on how the performance of the suggested classifier is affected by the quantity of characteristics that are chosen.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Near-End Communication System using Quarter wave Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The following paper describes a reliable and power efficient technique for communication between two short-range devices over wired or wireless networks, using a self-designed transmitter and receiver system modules. A fast and lossless Device to device communication (D2DC) is essential in the development of different electronic systems. In the present days, data transmission techniques are inefficient as they require an adequately large amount of time for transmission and reception. This paper presents a simple lossless technique for transmission and reception of data across wired systems or low range wireless systems by dividing the analog wave signal into four parts. The proposed technique is similar to QPSK as they both transmit encoded bits of data. The paper also describes the design of a communication system using the proposed Quarter wave communication technique that uses less power and has minimum data transmission and acquisition time.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of DC Servomotor with and without PID control under different loads for horizontal motion of MRI patient table
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This paper explores DC servomotor control for horizontal motion under variable, constant, and no-load conditions.
