It conducts a comparative analysis, focusing on the impact of a finely-tuned Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) controller. MATLAB/Simulink is employed to simulate the servomotor's mathematical model, evaluating performance metrics like rise time, settling time, overshoot, and steady-state error for PID and non-PID scenarios. Results highlight the PID controller's efficacy in accurately tracking step and ramp position references, minimizing overshoot across different loads. Comparative analysis reveals significant performance improvements with PID control, emphasizing its applicability in real-world horizontal motion applications. This research underscores the effectiveness of PID control strategies for enhancing DC servomotor performance.

articleTitle: BDIMFs Based Features Fusion and Classification for Glaucoma Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: There are various disorders in the humen eye. Glaucoma is one of the most critical eye disorders. Eye is a precious part of the human body. It develops in the eye with very less speed and damages all internal optic nerves. Outdated glaucoma prediction methods are more costly and slow. Various research works have been reported using multiresolution approaches and various features. A better work for glaucoma prediction using bi-dimensional intrinsic mode functions (BDIMFs) based features fusion and classification from fundus image is proposed. Adaptive BDIMFs are obtained from preprocessed color components. BDIMFs based features extraction and their fusion is the key idea of this work. BDIMFs based features are then normalized and classified with support vector machines (SVM). The pooled feature accuracy reached 97.7 with 10-fold cross-validation (FCV). Experimental analysis clearly shows the superiority of the proposed method over the traditional method.

articleTitle: Mitigation of Power Quality Issues in Power System using Static Synchronous Compensator
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In the power system, voltage stability is considered as a performance measurement parameter. So that different types of faults occur in power systems like long duration, short duration faults short-duration there are voltage sag, voltage swell, and voltage interaction. So, to achieve voltage stability STATCOM is used. A 24-volt Static Synchronous Compensator (STATCOM) model to mitigate power quality problems in power systems is presented in this article. Voltage fluctuations and flicker are just a few of the power quality problems that can affect the power system and cause significant financial losses as well as harm to electrical equipment. The STATCOM is an adaptable AC transmission system (FACTS) component that can efficiently control voltage and enhance the system’s power quality. The 24-volt model has a small, affordable design that works well for low-voltage uses. The STATCOM 24-volt model’s effectiveness at reducing problems with power quality in a power system is evaluated in the research. The outcomes of the simulations show that the STATCOM can efficiently control voltage, and reduce flicker, thereby enhancing the system’s total power quality. The findings also demonstrate that the 24-volt model is a practical choice for low-voltage uses, offering an affordable and effective remedy for problems with power quality in power systems.

articleTitle: Design of RF MEMS Switch free from unavoidable microwelding with low actuation voltage
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This paper gives a study based practical overview of Electrostatically actuated Radio Frequency MicroElectroMechanical-Systems (RF MEMS) Capacitive shunt switches. Switch configurations and their working principles in meeting the evolving demands of 5G technology are discussed. The study extensively reviews RF-MEMS switches, emphasizing their RF performance, actuation voltage, reliability, switching time to facilitate the seamless integration of RF-MEMS switches into 5G applications. The findings offer a comprehensive summary intended to serve as a valuable reference for future research endeavors aimed at optimizing the design and performance of RF-MEMS switches, particularly within the context of 5G and other high-performance applications.

articleTitle: The Sensitivity Influence Factors Analysis of Metasurface-based Sensor
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a metasurface-based sensor for material detection. By analyzing three factors that influence the performance of the sensor in the sensing model, the thickness of the material under test (MUT), the polarization and the incident angle of the electromagnetic wave. We determine that the thickness of the MUT is 10 mm, the electromagnetic wave polarization is horizontally polarization, and the incident angle is 20°. These factors significantly enhance the sensitivity and accuracy of the sensor, thereby improve the sensing performance.

articleTitle: Elevating Canteen Management with a Modern Web Solution
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In this paper, the author aims to remove the hassle of cash transactions from college canteen payments by streamlining the process. The present reliance on currency frequently proves inconvenient, particularly when precise amounts are needed, making change provision difficult. Educational establishment’s conventional canteen management scenario must improve with inefficiencies from manual record-keeping, monetary transactions, and user annoyances. This study offers a cutting-edge web-based system that could completely transform canteen operations in response to these issues. Our approach offers device-independent accessibility, unlike existing systems that are device-bound. The suggested system fully addresses these issues, guaranteeing a smooth and inclusive user experience across various devices. It is focused on essential areas like User Authen- tication and Profile Management, E-wallet Recharge, Database Management System Setup, Admin Access, and Transaction Notifications.

articleTitle: Dual-Band Frequency Reconfigurable Antenna In Unlicensed Ultra-Wideband Frequency Spectrum
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This paper presents a dual-band frequency reconfigurable antenna tailored for the unlicensed UWB frequency spectrum using a BAP65 pin diode. This antenna is fabricated using an FR4 substrate. Copper material was used in designing the top patch and ground plane in this antenna. The prescribed antenna size is 30mm×30mm×1.6mm. A total of four configurations of the antenna were presented on paper. The resonating antenna frequency in the ON ON condition is 7.3 GHz and 8.5 GHz. This antenna can obtain the reflection coefficient of -26.88 dB and -39.93 dB at the respective frequencies. A gain of 3.5 dBi can be observed in this antenna at the resonant frequency, which is accompanied by a radiation efficiency of 75.38%. This study highlights the design of the miniaturized reconfigurable antenna using an efficient pin diode as BAR65 such that the antenna resonates at multiple frequencies in the UWB frequency spectrum. The antenna can also be used as a band-notch filter.

articleTitle: Smart Water Monitoring with GSM Alerts: An IoT Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This paper introduces an advanced water pipeline monitoring system that optimizes infrastructure efficiency by integrating sensors and intelligent algorithms. The system, powered by an external Arduino board and GSM module, monitors water quality, temperature, turbidity, and pH levels. Unlike existing WiFi-dependent models, our wireless technology-based solution enhances adaptability and connectivity. Simulation results validate its effectiveness, emphasizing feasibility and potential impact. The system also includes an innovative alert feature, notifying users of deviations in water quality parameters, enhancing practicality and responsiveness. This research contributes to the discourse on water infrastructure management, offering a forward-thinking approach for resilient and sustainable practices.

Author Keywords: GSM (Global System for Mobile Communication) - Sensors ( Temperature sensor

articleTitle: Perfect Metamaterial Absorber for K-band Application
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This article studies a unique, compact, perfect metamaterial absorber. It contains a typical manufactured structure capable of achieving perfect metamaterial absorption. The unit cell structure was built with a three-square split ring resonator. This work consists of a 5mm×5mm unit cell to make the design compact, and FR4 epoxy was used as a dielectric substrate with a thickness of 1mm. The simulation outcomes have been done by ANSYS HFSS. The absorber's architecture was meticulously optimized using computational simulations and experimental validation, resulting in near-perfect absorptivity at the desired frequency. By tailoring the geometry, size, and composition of the metamaterial elements, we achieved a remarkable absorptivity of 100% at 20 GHz, effectively eliminating reflection and transmission losses.

articleTitle: Predictive Analytics for Website User Behavior Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This study examines the application of predictive analytics to user behavior analysis on websites, with a particular emphasis on a dataset of customer behavior from e-commerce. To forecast behavioral patterns, the study will apply the random forest method. Additionally, exploratory data analysis (EDA) will be carried out to extract insights from the dataset. The dataset employed in this study includes a variety of factors, such as purchase history, browsing habits, and consumer demographics, among other pertinent data. The research attempts to derive useful insights that can improve the comprehension and prediction of user behavior on the website by utilizing predictive analytics approaches. In this study, the random forest algorithm which is well-known for its capacity to manage intricate datasets and generate precise predictions is employed. The method builds several decision trees and combines their predictions to produce more reliable and accurate outcomes by utilizing ensemble learning. Predicting different aspects of user behavior, including browsing patterns, chance of making a purchase, and customer segmentation, is the aim. When paired with the insights from EDA, the outcomes of the behavioral analysis prediction made with the random forest algorithm can provide e-commerce companies with useful data. Gaining insight into user behavior can help with customer engagement, website design optimization, personalization, and overall user experience enhancement.

articleTitle: Fabrication Classifiation in Visual Tweets by Using Machine Learning with Deep Features
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In the context of online news outlets like Twitter, our work gives a summary of the situation as of rumor identification utilizing visual content. The majority of studies in the literature use visual content to illustrate several solutions to the issue. As opposed to combining them, we suggested an approach for Twitter rumours. The majority of our research work focuses on the use of supervised techniques, particularly deep learning models by utilising the deduced feature sets from the Twitter MediaEval dataset, which included 3000 images in total, a VGG-19 deep neural network was trained and evaluated. The VGG-19 achieves a highest sensitivity and an accuracy of using features taken from images during training and testing, which struggle to function in situations other than those in which they were trained. The simulation findings show that compared to other state-of-the-art architecture, the suggested design is more accurate and sensitive.

articleTitle: Drought Prediction for Farmers and Providing a Sustainable Farming Solution using IoT and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Drought is a severe natural event that affects agriculture greatly, particularly in regions where rain-fed agriculture is the main source of food. It has a major detrimental impact on society, the environment, and the lives of farmers. Drought prediction is an important component of early warning systems for drought management. Advances in machine learning (ML) and the Internet of Things (IoT) have demonstrated potential to improve drought prediction and provide sustainable farming solutions. In order to help farmers minimise the effects of drought and implement sustainable agricultural practices, we propose an IoT and ML drought prediction model in this work. We also discuss recommended farming practices that improve crop monitoring, irrigation, and decision-making through the use of IoT and ML technology. Along with outlining the model's limitations, we also provide recommendations for further research. In summary, our study aims to advance the field of drought prediction and sustainable farming practices by using the potential of IoT and ML technology.

articleTitle: Multi-Class Classification of Brain Tumours: Leveraging VGG, InceptionV3, and DenseNet201 Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In this study, brain tumour is classified on the Brain MRI(bt_dataset) dataset using Visual Geometry Group16(VGG), Inception V3 (Inv3), and DenseNet201(DN201) deep learning architectures. In this process, the models were developed for each architecture using Transfer learning, results were achieved, and the model with a minimum loss was introduced. The dataset used for the study is taken from the Kaggle website. The classification process was applied repeatedly on the bt_dataset, and the multi-class classification or prediction with the minimum error rate was aimed at the established models. In the study process, initially the bt_dataset was collected, prepared, pre-processed and visualized. Models were developed using the Jupiter Notebook editor via the Google Colaboratory. Then, the models were further examined and the most successful architecture was selected. As a result, according to the prediction/classification models, it was observed that the VGG architecture has achieved better results than the Inv3 model and the DN architecture.

articleTitle: A Broadband Circularly Polarized Crossed Bowtie Antenna
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This work proposes a broadband circularly polarized probe fed printed crossed bowtie dipole antenna. The antenna contains bowtie radiators being placed in a cross configuration on both sides of the substrate and backed by a thick cylindrical cavity. The antenna possesses an impedance bandwidth of 55% (1.01-1.77 GHz) w.r.t -10 dB reflection coefficient and an axial ratio bandwidth of 35% (1.05-1.50 GHz) w.r.t 3 dB axial ratio. It exhibits Right Hand Circular Polarization (RHCP) with a unidirectional radiation pattern and a stable gain of 8.60 dBic, 8.86 dBic, and 9.41 dBic over the frequencies of 1.17 GHz, 1.22 GHz, and 1.38 GHz respectively. It has an overall antenna size of 0.48λo × 0.62λo × 0.21λo where λo is the free space wavelength at the lowest frequency. This simple, compact, low weight and highly efficient antenna is proposed for L-band applications.

articleTitle: An Efficient Multiplier Architecture using Improved Full Adder Circuit
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The propose works shows an efficient multiplier architecture using improved full adder digital logic. The propose architecture is the workhorse in designing in digital signal processing (DSP) system, which enable to perform complex mathematical operations with improved efficiency and accuracy also improved in the field of area, power, delay etc. In this work, a modified improved full adder circuit to design multiplier circuit which improves circuit performance in terms of power and delay. In Improved full adder approx 30% of power decreased than Conventional Full adder circuit and in modified Multiplier approx 26% of power decreased than Normal Multiplier Circuit. Xilinx Vivado 2020.1 simulation software is used for designing multiplier circuit.

articleTitle: Developing a framework to conduct ageing studies in Insulating Oil for Power and Distribution Transformers
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Due to significant dielectric properties of Mineral Oil (MO) it has been used as an insulating oil in Power Transformer (PT) and Distribution Transformer (DT). The critical functions of the insulating oil dies as it ages and needs to be replaced periodically. The ageing of insulating oil gives data that can be used to develop predictive model. With the use of predictive model one can predict the deterioration rate of an oil. The ageing model or predictive model requires a framework to streamline the ageing test on oils. The method is overwhelmed by various ideas of ageing model adopted from previous literature. Upon using the ageing framework, the new ageing method and standards can be developed in future. Hence, the review catapulted the designing of new ageing model to predict the deterioration of oil under transformer environment.

articleTitle: ELM Anti-Jamming Technique Based on Enhanced Multiple Input Multiple Output(MIMO) signal
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Extreme learning machine(ELM) is an anti-jamming technique that has a wide range of utilities, We have verified and compared the results by using the Matlab Software. We have explained the transmitter, radio channel, and acquisition in this paper. The purpose is to describe the Extreme Learning Machine and to check whether it provides better output as compared to other anti- jamming techniques such as normalized least mean squares filter and recursive least square filter. Extreme learning machines prove to be successful tools while simulating it using Matlab code.

articleTitle: Variable Frequency Waves at Different Level Deposited PBM Technique for Seven-Level Inverter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The expansion of inverters to more than two layers with the goal of reducing distortion from the fundamental sinusoidal waveform is where the concept of a multiple leveled inverter originated. Using multiple-level inverters has the disadvantage of adding more switches, which increases system bulk and expense and lowers system dependability as a result of the increased component count. In this art, a variable frequency waves at different level deposited PWM technique is presented. The model along with control is built on Simulink and the results are studied and compared with alternate phase deposited pulse breadth modulation (APDPBM) scheme to verify its performance.

Author Keywords: alternate phase deposited pulse breadth modulation (APDPBM)

articleTitle: Analysis of Chronic Liver Disease Detection by Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: A significant cause of illness and death across the globe, chronic liver disease affects millions of people every year. Improving patient outcomes and decreasing the strain on healthcare systems depend on early identification and management. Over the last several years, advances in machine learning technology have shown great promise in helping physicians detect chronic liver disease in its earliest stages. This review aims to assess how well machine learning methods work and where they fall short in identifying the early stages of chronic liver disease. This study assesses the present status of research through a review of the relevant literature, experimental investigations, and clinical applications. The research critically assesses the efficacy of machine learning models regarding precision, recall, and transfer. The paper explores how aspects such as sample size, feature selection, and model complexity affect the efficiency of such methods.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Deep Learning Models for Accurate Glaucoma Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The realm of healthcare, machine learning has emerged as an especially profound, is easy to use and fairly accurate method for easy solutions and making medical procedures more and more accurate. This research study focuses on glaucoma, which is one of the more common and yet less spoken of visual disorders in the country and in the world. Seeing the predicted increased load on the health system with this disease we propose of flurry of comparison between potential machine learning solutions and deep learning models that can detect easily and accurate glaucoma within patients reducing the doctor’s workload is proposed. The potential models picked for this work are inceptionv3, ResNet50, VGG16, VGG19, Xception and a custom convolutional neural network (CCNN) as well. The obtained accuracy (in %) for glaucoma detection is 99.43 using VGG19. This may provide an effective application and solution for glaucoma detection.

articleTitle: Evaluating Security enhancement through Machine Learning Approaches for Anomaly Based Intrusion Detection Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: A critical aspect of enhancing cybersecurity involves employing the anomaly-based Intrusion Detection System (IDS), which relies on machine learning methodologies for optimal functionality. Nonetheless, an investigation into existing IDS research uncovers issues regarding arbitrary algorithm choice, parameter selection, utilization of old datasets, and inadequate result analysis. To mitigate these challenges, a comprehensive analysis juxtaposes prior IDS studies against diverse attack scenarios and the dataset CICIDS2017. This study examines two well-known machine learning algorithms, detailing specific models for each, analyzing their training parameters, and utilizing various metrics for performance evaluation. The evaluation is conducted by the multiclass dataset CICIDS2017, which is recognized for its class imbalance and realistic representation of attacks. The results highlight the effectiveness of the first Random Forest Classifier and second Decision Tree Classifier models in detecting web attacks compared to other methods. These models demonstrate outstanding performance in terms of memory usage, A-accuracy, P-precision, and FScore, achieving an accuracy rate of 98.07% and a recall rate of 98.12%. By addressing previous shortcomings in intrusion detection system IDS research and offering insights into optimal parameters and algorithmic selections, this research contributes to a better understanding of IDS effectiveness in real-world network environments.

articleTitle: Flame Frenzy Fighter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Our research project aims to develop and implement a revolutionary fire extinguishing robot carefully adapted for the detection and autonomous extinguishing of fires in enclosed spaces. The lack of immediate human intervention in fire alarm systems often causes significant damage, highlighting the need for automated fire protection solutions. Our robot, equipped with flame detection and control sensors, has the ability to quickly detect fire sources and approach them autonomously with unmatched precision. This remotecontrolled marvel ensures a safe and effective response to fires, eliminating the need for human intervention in dangerous situations. This research represents a significant step forward in improving safety, preventing disasters, and saving lives from home fires. This is an important milestone in the field of autonomous robotics and could revolutionize our approach to residential fire safety and disaster management in private homes as well as commercial establishment.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of Various Load Balancing Algorithm in Cloud Computing Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This research paper conducts a thorough and comparative analysis of various load balancing algorithms in cloud computing environments, aiming to provide valuable insights for cloud administrators and architects in their decision-making process. The research methodology involves creating a controlled experimental environment that mirrors typical cloud infrastructures. Performance metrics such as demand response time, server load, throughput, demand distribution fairness, scalability, and resource usage are considered, with real data from cloud environments enhancing the analysis. Both quantitative and qualitative data, supported by advanced statistical tools and data visualization techniques, are employed to shed light on the overall merits of each load balancing algorithm. This research empowers cloud professionals with the knowledge to navigate intricate realm of load balancing in cloud computing, thereby enhancing the performance, flexibility, and scalability of their cloud systems.

articleTitle: Enhancing Cross-Domain Recommendation System using a Novel hybrid NLP Based Text Vectorization and Unsupervised Machine Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Recommendation systems play a pivotal role in enhancing user experiences in various domains. Cross-domain recommendations, where preferences and behaviours from one domain are leveraged to make recommendations in another, are of particular interest. This research paper presents approach to enhance cross-domain recommendations through a hybrid system that combines natural language processing text vectorization and k-means based modelling. The methodology in this paper involves converting movie titles into high-dimensional vectors, which capture semantic information related to the films. These vectors are then integrated with a k-means-based recommendation model, which allows to recommend movies as well as books based on movie titles. To evaluate the effectiveness of the mentioned approach, few comprehensive experiments on real-world data was conducted. The results demonstrate a significant improvement in recommendation accuracy and the ability to bridge the gap between seemingly disparate domains. There is a discussion on the implications of the findings and the potential for broader applications. This research paper contributes to the ongoing efforts to improve cross-domain recommendation systems and showcases the power of hybrid techniques.

articleTitle: An Approach to Detecting Writing Styles Based on Clustering Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: With the advancement of AI technology, the generation of content has become easier and more accessible. In such a scenario, it is difficult to differentiate between human-generated text and AI-generated text. To address this concern, our methodology proposes an intelligent system capable of analyzing text files and classifying unique writing styles using stylometric analysis. This work also compares various clustering algorithms, including k-means, k-means++, hierarchical, and DBSCAN, utilizing silhouette scores as performance metrics. This ensures the effectiveness of our system in distinguishing between similar and dissimilar writing styles based on advanced linguistic and structural features of text. Our tools separate text of different styles and clustered it together to provide a valuable solution for detecting plagiarism across multiple document files by grouping it. Our system demonstrated its efficacy by successfully identifying two distinct writing styles within a document. This highlights the practical application and accuracy of our approach in effectively addressing complex challenges associated with stylistic differences and the potential for plagiarism detection.

articleTitle: Exploring A Two-Phase Deep Learning Framework For Network Intrusion Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Intrusion detection systems (IDS) often use machine learning and deep learning to identify and categorize cyber-attacks swiftly. However, as these attacks expand, a robust response becomes crucial. Despite the availability of numerous intrusion detection datasets, there’s limited research assessing model performance across various public datasets. Continuous updates and benchmarking of these datasets remain crucial due to evolving attack strategies. This study compares the proposed model with convolutional neural network (CNN) and deep neural network (DNN) models to create a versatile and effective IDS. Adapting IDS to handle evolving network behaviours and increasing assaults necessitates dynamic approaches with large datasets. Combining autoencoders (AE) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) in our new two-stage deep learning method demonstrates effectiveness in detecting assaults using CICIDS2017 and CSE-CICDIS2018 datasets.

articleTitle: Prediction of Wind Turbine Bearing Faults: A Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In this paper, we present a near investigation of five different AI algorithms for the fault classification of wind turbines in MATLAB: NN (Neural Networks), KNN (k-Nearest acquaintances), TREE (choice timber), SVM (Support Vector Machines), and Kernel SVM. We evaluated the performance of these algorithms on a real-world dataset of wind turbine condition data. Neural networks were the most computationally expensive to train but also the most accurate. SVM and kernel SVM were less computationally expensive than neural networks but were also less accurate. KNN and decision trees were the most efficient to train, but they were also the least accurate. Overall, our results suggest that neural networks are the best choice for the predictive classification of wind turbine faults in MATLAB. Still, SVM and kernel SVM may be better choices for applications where computational efficiency is more important than accuracy.

articleTitle: NobleShield: Empowering Communities for Safer Public Spaces
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This research paper presents the development and implementation of NobleShield, an open-source crowdsourcing platform designed to address safety concerns in public spaces by collecting anonymous personal stories. The platform uses mapping technology to show local data trends, empowering individuals, communities, and administrations to work collaboratively towards solutions. With a focus on inclusivity and community-driven initiatives, NobleShield aims to create awareness on street harassment and abuse, encouraging individuals to break their silence and contribute to a new data set that enhances our understanding of safety issues in public spaces. The paper outlines the methodology, platform architecture, data analysis, community impact, documentation strategies, and future directions, emphasizing the platform’s potential for making communities safer and more Knowledgeable.

articleTitle: Policy Learning-Based Image Captioning With Vision Transformer
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In light of the remarkable progress made in automated image caption generation, it is still challenging to create captions that accurately reflect factual information and yet capture the nuances of human language. It tries to provide captions that accurately explain both the visual content and the complexity and indirectness of human emotion. The existing model represents a fusion of the CNN's capacity to comprehend the visual elements within an image and the RNN's expertise in crafting sequential language structures tailored to various visual contexts. This research paper combines the diverse methods of VITs for image understanding, pre-trained language models for language fluency and nuance, and fact-checking mechanisms to ensure factual accuracy. Attention algorithms and diversity checks improve the overall quality of captions provided. Reinforcement learning entails fine-tuning the model's performance iteratively.

articleTitle: Implementation Challenges and Performance Analysis of Image Compression Using Huffman Encoding and DCT Algorithm on DSP Processor TMS320C6748 and Arduino Nano 33 BLE
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: To strike a compromise between compression ratio and image quality, this work focuses on a complete approach to image compression that combines Huffman coding (HC) and discrete cosine transform (DCT). The mathematical underpinnings of DCT and practical applications are examined, with a focus on how well it reduces redundancy. To further improve compression effectiveness, the project incorporates the entropy coding process known as Huffman coding after the DCT phase. By giving shorter codes to symbols that appear frequently, Huffman coding enhances the representation of altered visual data. The paper covers optimization strategies and design concerns for using Huffman coding with Discrete Cosine Transform. The study evaluates image compression techniques employing DCT and HC transforms to determine superior outcomes in terms of peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR), compression ratio, and root mean square error (RMSE) and to perform image compression efficiently.

articleTitle: River Path Change Detection using Satellite Images
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: River path change detection is an important task in environmental monitoring and analysis. Traditional methods of detecting changes in river paths have relied on manual inspection of satellite images, which is time-consuming and prone to errors. The paper presents a computer vision-based approach for the dataset of USGS Earth Explorer is used for statistical analysis of the Krishna River path changes over 30 years from 1994 to 2023. In this study, the region of the riverbed is segmented using OTSU’s thresholding and color contour detection. Statistical features such as contour length, area, perimeter, and centroid are utilized to analyze the geographical changes and possible impact on irrigation needs.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of P&O and Fuzzy logic based MPPT methods for Bi-facial Photovoltaic module
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: A power tracking system is necessary for a photovoltaic (PV) system to monitor the maximum working power. The maximum power point tracking (MPPT) technique ensures that the system works efficiently in ever-changing irradiance and temperature conditions. To investigate the effectiveness of the MPPT approach, a solitary bifacial PV model is proposed. Bifacial solar panels have the capability of generating more power compared to conventional solar panels. The advantage of high-power density is because of the non-reflective front and back surfaces. The conventional Perturb and observe algorithm (P&O) and the artificial intelligence-based fuzzy logic control (FLC) approaches are compared among themselves. The two MPPT approaches are analyzed according to bifacial gain, bifaciality factor, and panel efficiency. The comparison aims to show that the fuzzy-logic control outperforms the conventional P&O approach at standard as well as varying conditions of temperature and irradiance.

articleTitle: Analysis and Simulation of Lithium-ion Battery Cell Balancing by using the Matlab for Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Recent years have seen an increase in research interest in battery management systems, where cell equalization is crucial. Even though a lot of time and effort has gone into creating different cell equalization structures, there are still a lot of areas that might be improved upon in terms of performance. Specifically, there is a lack of systematic investigation and mathematical modeling of equalization systems. This study presents the results of an analytical performance investigation of the modularized global equalizer system for lithium-ion battery cell equalization. In particular, a mathematical model that takes energy loss and charging/discharging into account is created to mimic the equalization processes. The energy loss and equalization speed of the introduced model are also compared with the latest structures. According to numerical simulations, the modularized global equalization works better than the others because it uses far fewer equalizers and significantly less energy loss with comparable equalization performance. In addition, a module segmentation guide is provided to facilitate the equalization system design. Keywords—buck converter, soft switching, zero voltage switching, resonant impedance.

articleTitle: Early Diagnosis of Endometrial Cancer: An Ensemble-Based Deep Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Early diagnosis and treatment are key to improving the prognosis of endometrial cancer. However, conventional machine learning approaches have limited capacity to simulate the complex links between histopathological images and their interpretations, making it challenging to achieve accurate results. The objective of this paper is to develop a machine learning algorithm for the accurate diagnosis of endometrial cancer using histopathology images. A machine learning-based ensemble method was utilized to classify histopathology images into four categories). Three pre-trained convolutional neural network architectures, namely VGG16, DenseNet121, and MobileNetV2, were employed for feature extraction. The last convolutional layer of each CNN is used for high level feature extraction from the input and single feature vector is the output of these concatenated layers. The concatenated feature vector was then fed into a softmax layer for classification. The dataset consisted of 3302 histopathology images classified into four categories. The proposed algorithm achieved an accuracy of 97.17%, F-score of 96.79%, sensitivity of 97.17%, and precision of 97.25%. These results demonstrate its potential for facilitating early detection and diagnosis of endometrial cancer. The methodology of concatenating multiple pre-trained CNNs and utilizing their extracted features provides a robust and accurate approach for endometrial cancer classification

articleTitle: Miniaturized Narrow Band Patch Antenna For GPS Application Using Technique of Mini Slot Insertion
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The paper explores the size reduction in a narrowband PCB antenna intended for GPS applications through a mini-slot insertion technique. The PCB antenna’s measurements are reduced to 30mm×50mm×1.6mm while resonating at a GPS frequency of 1.55GHz. The shown GPS PCB antenna covers the bandwidth of 1.52 GHz to 1.59 GHz, which contemplates the GPS frequency of 1.575 GHz. The shown PCB antenna demonstrates the highest gain of 0.18 abs at the peak frequency of 1.59GHz. It obtains a return loss of -21.30 dB at the mentioned frequency. The shown GPS PCB antenna has an overall gain of 0.11 abs at the resonating frequency of 1.55 GHz. The shown PCB antenna obtains a radiation efficiency of 13.16%. The paper introduces a method to reduce measurements through the slot insertion technique. Reducing the measurements of the PCB antenna at the cost of gain and efficiency emitted by the PCB antenna makes up for the resonance shift.

articleTitle: Sensor-Driven Landslide Detection System for the South Eastern Region of India
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Landslides, a pervasive natural calamity, can lead to catastrophic outcomes when they transpire in proximity to human settlements and infrastructural facilities. The identification and surveillance of landslides are paramount for mitigating the hazards associated with these geological phenomena. One innovative approach to landslide detection involves the utilization of Arduino-based sensor technology. These sensors are designed to monitor alterations in the terrain’s gradient, serving as an indicator of potential landslide activity. A cost-effective early warning system can be engineered using an Arduino Uno board, a microcontroller predicated on the ATmega328P, in conjunction with an MPU 6050 accelerometer and gyroscope sensor, and a Soil and Humidity Sensor. This system can provide preliminary alerts for impending landslides, thereby enhancing the efficacy of evacuation procedures.

articleTitle: Real-Time Network Optimization in 6G minimizing End-to-End Delay Using SARSA Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: As 6G networks take off, there is an increasing need for effective system optimization strategies that can decrease end-to-end (e2e) delay and improve the general efficiency of the network. The SARSA (State-Action-Reward-State-Action) algorithm, which can learn from the network ecosystem and optimize network parameters accordingly, is the foundation of the unique real-time network optimization approach that is suggested in this research. With the aid of a simulation environment that replicates the actual 6G network environment, we assess the suggested approach. Our findings show that, the SARSA algorithm may substantially decrease e2e delay and improve network performance. In general, this research offers an intriguing plan for network optimization in 6G networks and emphasizes the SARSA algorithm's potential for improving real-time network reliability.

articleTitle: Corner Disinfection Robot
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This paper introduces the Corner Disinfection Robot as a ground-breaking response to the unique hygiene demands posed by the pandemic. The COVID-19 pandemic has underscored the critical importance of robust hygiene measures, creating an urgent need for innovative solutions to address sanitation challenges. Traditional cleaning methods often fall short of effectively disinfecting hard-to-reach corners and confined spaces, exacerbating the risk of pathogen transmission.The need for comprehensive disinfection has become particularly pressing in environments like healthcare facilities, public transportation, and crowded public spaces. Existing methods, inadequate in reaching corners, necessitate a paradigm shift. The robot, equipped with ultraviolet light disinfection autonomously navigates and effectively disinfects challenging hard-to-reach areas.By mitigating the limitations of traditional cleaning approaches, the robot not only addresses the immediate challenges presented by the COVID-19 pandemic but also contributes to long-term hygiene management strategies. The robot’s autonomous operation minimizes the risk of human exposure in high-risk areas, enhancing both safety and efficacy. The robot covers approximately 80% of the targeted area. This research offers a timely and innovative solution to the hygiene challenges amplified by the pandemic, providing a glimpse into the future of autonomous and targeted disinfection technologies.

articleTitle: No Connectivity zone wireless communication and Human Detection using RF Module and PIR sensor
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This paper presents a wireless communication system utilizing a 433MHz RF module alongside human presence detection using a Passive Infrared (PIR) sensor. The system is designed to enable real-time monitoring of human presence in a specific area. At the transmitter end, four push buttons are integrated and linked to an encoder, allowing the user to transmit specific signals wirelessly. When a button is pressed, the encoder encodes the corresponding data, which is then transmitted via the RF module to the receiver end. On the receiver side, four LEDs are connected, with each LED corresponding to one of the push buttons. When a button is pressed at the transmitter, the encoded data is received, decoded, and used to control the respective LED, providing a visual indication of the activated button. This system offers a versatile and reliable means of wireless communication with human presence detection, making it useful for applications like home automation and security systems where no connectivity is possible. Also in farm controlling equipment, educational institutions, commercial buildings, healthcare systems, emergency wards/departments.

articleTitle: PLC & SCADA For Efficient Load Management And Fault Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This paper presents a real-time prototype design and implementation of an automatic control system for the supply of electrical loads. The system utilizes a Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) in conjunction with Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) to ensure continuous power supply by dynamically switching between different sources based on priority. The prioritization scheme involves cutting off the least priority load in the absence of any one of the three power sources. The programming is accomplished through ladder logic, a graphical representation commonly used in PLCs. The communication between the PLC and SCADA is established to provide a centralized interface for fault monitoring and control. The proposed system has been physically implemented, demonstrating its effectiveness in industrial applications where uninterrupted power supply is crucial. The presented work contributes to the advancement of automation and control systems, offering a practical solution for managing and optimizing electrical loads in real-time scenarios.

articleTitle: AyurMedVerify: Medicinal Plant Authentication System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Medicinal plants have been highly significant to the medical field in curing diseases, healing wounds, and treating the ill since ancient times. The production and supply of these medicinal plants, however, pose authentication issues due to dependent and trust-based deals. To address this matter, we propose the design and development of a framework for the identification and classification of medicinal leaves using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) for accurate detection of medicinal leaves. This system lists the information of companies dealing in the particular medicinal leaf. The CNN model, leveraging the Indian Medicinal Leaves Dataset demonstrates progressive accuracy through experimentation. The solution aims to improve transparency and accountability in the supply chain of the medicinal leaf industry. This innovative approach improves the credibility and integrity of Ayurvedic medicines while empowering medicinal industry stakeholders.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation of Green Electric Vehicle Charging Station using MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: With the increasing global focus on electric vehicles, requirement of electric vehicle charging infrastructure has become imperative. Green electric vehicle (GEV) charging station is designed for recharging electric vehicles using environmentally sustainable and energy-efficient technologies. This paper presents a study on the modeling and simulation of GEV charging station. MATLAB simulation model assembles for the GEV charging station. The proposed methodology consists of a photovoltaic array, stationary storage battery, electric vehicle charging station battery and power grid.

articleTitle: Deformation Monitoring of Wind Turbine Blades Based on Millimeter-Wave Radar
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a method for measuring wind turbine blade deformation using millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar. The radar is securely mounted on the nacelle without disrupting the turbine's operation, and its beam direction is adjusted to cover the blade's tail. Leveraging millimeter-wave radar's ranging capability and high-resolution angle measurement via Multiple-Input Multiple-Output (MIMO), we successfully capture distance and angle information of the blades. Using this data, we determine the relative coordinates of the blade's tail and compare it with the original state, allowing us to measure wind turbine blade deformation. Results indicate that deformation is more pronounced at the bottom of the blade, decreasing as it extends upward, aligning with logical expectations. This validates the effectiveness and feasibility of our measurement method.

articleTitle: E-Navigation: The Boon for Visually Impaired
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Within this paper, we offer a momentous arrangement named "E-navigation: The Boon for Outwardly Disabled" pointed at revolutionizing the lives of people confronting visual disabilities. This groundbreaking framework coordinating ultrasonic sensors, GPS innovation, fire sensors, and area following to offer broad bolster to the outwardly disabled community. By utilizing ultrasonic waves and GPS, this framework empowers impediment location, real-time route, and the sharing of area subtle elements with family individuals. Furthermore, it incorporates fire sensors to upgrade security by alarming clients to potential fire dangers, especially basic for those incapable to outwardly distinguish such perils. Emphasizing reasonableness and effectiveness, this innovation points to enable people with visual impedances over a wide range. With around 39 million individuals all-inclusive hooking with visual inabilities, the potential effect of this route framework is considerable. Its execution guarantees upgraded consolation, expanded speed, and reinforced certainty in route for the outwardly impeded, cultivating more prominent freedom and cooperation in different angles of life. "E-navigation: The Boon for Outwardly Disabled" implies an inventive and promising progression balanced to altogether upgrade the lives of millions confronting challenges due to visual disability.

articleTitle: Automatic generation control and its impact on long-term voltage and Frequency stability
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This paper explores the critical role of Automatic Generation Control (AGC) in maintaining and enhancing the long-term voltage and Frequency stability of power systems. Voltage and Frequency stability is a fundamental aspect of power system operation, ensuring the reliable and secure delivery of electricity to consumers. AGC, as an integral part of modern power systems, plays a pivotal role in achieving and maintaining voltage stability by regulating the balance between generation and demand.The primary objective of AGC is to adjust the output of generators in real-time to maintain the system’s frequency within acceptable limits. However, the impact of AGC extends beyond frequency control, influencing voltage levels and ultimately contributing to long-term voltage and frequency stability. This paper delves into the mechanisms through which AGC affects voltage and frequency stability, including its role in reactive power control, load shedding, and optimal generation scheduling. Implement, through computer simulations, an electrical system and analyze the impact of AGC on long-term voltage and frequency stability (AGC-LTVFS). This article choose and implement a test electrical system to carry out computer simulations. Then the behavior of the system is analysed based on the different simulations and the results are compared. It is concluded about the impact of AGC-LTVFS.

articleTitle: Design of Full Adder Circuits with Optimized Power and Speed Using CMOS Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Circuits for a 1-bit complete adder are proposed in this paper. The suggested circuits have very low power consumption and minimal delay [1]. CMOS technology is used to develop various complete adder circuits with low power consumption and minimal delay. Cadence Virtuoso at 90nm technology is used to implement these, with a 1.8V supply voltage. The power consumption [2], delay, and area parametric restrictions are compared with various complete adder circuit designs, and comments are made on which design provides the best performance parameter. The Power Delay Product indicates the circuit’s efficiency. Since the primary focus of VLSI research is low power design, create circuits with low power, little area, and little latency. The whole adder circuit design performance is related to the complete design performance.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of High Throughput and Efficient FIR Filter Architectures Using Pipelining
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: A methodology to improve throughput and efficiency of FIR (Finite Impulse Response) filter architectures by using pipelining is addressed in this paper. Low pass FIR filter of broadcast type structure of 11 tap is designed to improve throughput and efficiency. Feed-Forward Cutset pipelining method is used to pipeline proposed low pass FIR filter architectures. 16 bit RCA (Ripple Carry Adder) and 8*8 bit vedic multiplier is used to do addition and multiplication operations of the proposed FIR filter architectures. VHDL (VHSIC Hardware Description Language) language and Xilinx Vivado 2015.2 tool are used to design, simulation and synthesis. There is an improvement of 50% in area utilization (in terms of Look up Tables) for the implemented 11 tap broadcast FIR filter architectures in comparison with existing 2-tap and 3-tap FIR filter architectures. Also an improvement of 46% in speed for the implemented 11 tap broadcast FIR filter architectures in comparison with existing 2-tap, 3-tap and 4-tap FIR filter architectures.

articleTitle: Ensemble Modeling of Epitopes and Non-Epitopes Prediction from Protein Sequences of Zika and Dengue Viruses
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Finding specific parts in a protein sequence that trigger an immune response is crucial for understanding how diseases develop, creating vaccines, and using the immune system to treat cancer. Due to many pathogen sequences being fully or partially sequenced for proteins, it's too costly and time-consuming to use experimental methods to locate these parts. In this paper, an ensemble model is proposed to predict Epitopes and Non-epitopes from protein sequences. The experimental results were determined using datasets from the ZIKA and Dengue viruses. The proposed Ensemble Model achieved the highest accuracy of 95.36% for the Zika dataset and 89.60% for the Dengue dataset. These final results can be compared with existing state-of-the-art methods. The new combination model aims to predict potential vaccines for ZIKA and Dengue, potentially saving lives globally and preventing significant outbreaks of these diseases in the future.

articleTitle: Compensator design for DC-DC converters to improve the performance of the system
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: A DC-DC converter in the context of power electronics is a device which is used to power distribution in different level (E.g., lights, sensors, motor control etc.). Now a days with the increasing demand of Electric Vehicles (EVs), not only design of converter but also good controller/compensator is required to improve efficiency of converter and reliability of the system for users. In the context of power electronics, compensator is used to upgrade the behavior and stability of a converter. This paper presents the study on stability analysis & implementation of compensator for DC-DC converters as per requirement whereas an example of buck converter has used as reference. The proposed converter topology is discussed & as per requirement designed compensator for the buck converter. MATLAB is utilized as the simulation platform to model and analyze the open loop & closed loop system of the converter.

articleTitle: Android Based Real-Time Picture-to-Audio Converter for the Visually Impaired
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In spite of advances being made in modern technology and computer vision models. However, they usually lack the effective intelligent solutions for understanding and interpreting objects. This object recognition and conversion to speech as a broadcasting can be used for visually impaired people to address their unique challenges traversing through life. There is a pressing need for a nuanced approach that alliance with the transformers functionality to accept, understand, and tread through the vast expense of features that are extracted from the images that are received as an input to the model and then processed for their efficient identification accurately so that this identification used in real life. This tech is hereby used for a variety of tasks such as QR codes, recognizing currency codes, fruits, vegetables, street signs, etc. This is used to build an environment more inclusive and catering to the needs of the visually challenged.

articleTitle: Exploring Machine Learning Techniques for Enhanced Breast Cancer Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Breast cancer is the second-greatest cause of death for women worldwide, affecting the majority of them. On the other hand, if cancer is identified early and adequately treated, it may be cured. Patients' chances of survival and prognosis can be greatly improved by early identification of breast cancer and prompt treatment intervention. Additionally, accurate benign tumor classification might assist patients in avoiding unnecessary therapy. This study provides a thorough overview of several studies that examined how ML algorithms may be used to find breast cancer. The main goal is to evaluate these algorithms' performance in terms of precision, accuracy, recall, and overall effectiveness. This evaluation tries to identify the most promising approaches and indicate areas for further development by looking at a wide variety of algorithms.

articleTitle: Classification of Power Quality Disturbance using Stockwell Transform
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This research aims to target power quality disturbances and achieve precise classification using innovative machine-learning techniques. Effective mitigation is required for these disturbances to impact equipment and system stability. Our method is superior to conventional methods in that it utilizes S-transform for feature extraction due to its simultaneous time-frequency localization. We demonstrate how the S-transform captures intricate details of flow disturbances by incorporating Naive Bayes, Random Forest, and K-Nearest Neighbors algorithms. The accuracy of these algorithms is commendable, but their effectiveness in classifying disorders varies. This study presents a tool that automates issue detection and classification, providing a valuable framework for managing power quality. The implementation of this approach will lead to more reliable and stable power systems, which will address a critical need in power quality analysis.

articleTitle: Virtual Eye: Object Recognition for Blind
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Object recognition for blind people is a technology that aims to improve the quality of life for people with visual impairments. The technology uses computer vision and machine learning algorithms to analyze images captured by cameras and provide audio feedback about objects in the surroundings. The system identifies objects such as people, vehicles, obstacles, and other items of interest and provides real-time feedback to the user. The technology can be integrated into wearable devices such as smart glasses or mobile phones to provide a portable and convenient solution for the visually impaired. Object recognition for blind people is an ongoing research area, and advances in machine learning and computer vision are likely to lead to further improvements in this technology in the future. The object recognition accuracy for various objects is around 95 per cent.

articleTitle: Comparison of Hysteresis margin and Hysteresis width Schmitt Trigger Oscillators using logic gates in 28nm CMOS Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This study compares two Schmitt trigger circuits with different parameters of the circuits like higher threshold and lower threshold. This configuration utilizes the properties of NAND gates to create a hysteresis effect, allowing for noise filtering and reliable threshold-based switching. The Schmitt trigger is commonly used in digital circuits, such as in the design of oscillators, waveform generators, and pulse generators. The 28 nm CMOS technology’s Cadence and model parameters are employed to evaluate the recommended circuits’ performance.

articleTitle: A Blockchain Based Market Place For Non-Fungible Token
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The emergence of blockchain technology has propelled the evolution of digital asset ownership, notably through Non-Fungible Tokens (NFTs). This research paper explores the design, implementation, and implications of a blockchain-based marketplace specifically tailored for NFTs. NFTs, unique digital assets indivisible into smaller units, have gained immense traction across various domains, including art, gaming, collectibles, and real estate, revolutionizing the concept of ownership in the digital space.This paper delineates the fundamental principles of NFTs, elucidating their cryptographic underpinnings and the decentralized nature of blockchain that ensures provenance, scarcity, and immutability. It examines the technological architecture and functionalities required for the establishment of a robust marketplace dedicated to NFTs. Through a comprehensive analysis of existing blockchain-based platforms and marketplaces, this research identifies the strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, and threats prevalent in the current landscape. Ultimately, this research contributes to the burgeoning field of blockchain technology by offering insights into the development and optimization of a specialized marketplace for NFTs.

articleTitle: Adaptive Reconfigurable LFSR: Dynamic Tapping and Reseeding for Enhanced Pseudo Random Number Generation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The paper presents a reconfigurable Linear Feedback Shift Register (LFSR) that has the capacity to reseed and is composed of a seed generator circuit which is a 4-bit LFSR. The size of the pseudorandom pattern generator is 64 bit. The 4-bit LFSR functions as both the seed generator and selector of the feedback path for the 64-bit LFSR. The inputs of the circuit are clock, reset, select lines (s), and seed. After the reset initializes the LFSR the select lines (s) determines the mode of the LFSR i.e., internal (s=0) or external (s=1). The circuit yields a 64-bit output, with tap points dynamically chosen based on the 4-bit LFSR output, increasing the randomness of generated patterns. The design offers enhanced control over pseudo-random number generation through reseeding and configurable taps. The simulation software used is Xilinx Vivado 2020.1 and the design is implemented in Verilog.

articleTitle: Design of High frequency opto-regulated Flyback Converter for variable AC Drives
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: As it is seen that Flyback converter has been widely used in low power offline application due to its simplicity and cost effectiveness. For our application that requires delivering an average output power of 50 Watt, a choke filter is used instead of a power transformer. The output voltage and output current are typically sensed and managed by an isolated feedback circuit with an optocoupler which in turn sends the signal to PWM controller. The PWM controller can operate up to 500kHz. The regulated output voltage designated is 24 V which is fed to the AC drives for its operation. Flyback converters are often used for DC-DC conversion and electrical isolation because they are simple to use, have a low component count, and are compact.

articleTitle: Power Flow Management in AC-DC hybrid Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This research prosed power flow controller system to control DC-AC hybrid distribution generating network power consumption. The proposed energy management system considers distributed generation, load demand, and battery charge. Multi-bidirectional converters connect AC and DC networks to create a hybrid microgrid. AC power supply and AC loads are tied in AC grid, whereas DC supply and loads are in the DC grid. Battery unit connected to AC and DC connectors. The system's control and operation account for ambient wind, ambient temperature, irradiation, and load variability. A compact hybrid grid model simulated using MATLAB Simulink. The simulation shows that the coordination control technique manages load demand.

articleTitle: DCGAN for Synthetic Data Augmentation of Cervical Cancer for Improved Cervical Cancer Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Medical diagnosis and treatment are greatly aided by biomedical image analysis. Deep learning model training is difficult, nevertheless, due to the scarcity of labelled medical images. For creating synthetic biological images to supplement the training data, Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) have shown good promise. In this research paper, we focus on the application of GANs for biomedical image augmentation. Specifically, we investigate and compare the performance of a prominent GAN architecture: Deep Convolutional GAN (DCGAN) is a variant of GAN specifically designed for image generation tasks. We assess the generated images based on their quality, diversity, and preservation of biomedical aspects using different evaluation metrics. We also used a classification process to compare the classifier on real and synthetic augmented data. Our test findings show that DCGAN is capable of producing realistic synthetic biomedical images. The results of this work advance knowledge of GANs for biomedical image enhancement and offer guidance on choosing the DCGAN designs for tasks requiring medical image analysis. Researchers and practitioners can increase the diversity and quantity of training data by utilizing GAN-based augmentation strategies, which will enhance the performance and generalization of deep learning models in biomedical applications.The primary objective of this study is to evaluate the effectiveness of DCGAN in generating synthetic microscopic biomedical images of cervical cancer that can augment the training data for deep learning classification models. We aim to assess the quality, diversity, and preservation of biomedical features in the generated images.The structure of this study is as follows: we begin by brief introduction of Cervical cancer, GAN in general and DCGAN. Section 2: lays down review of the related literature. Section 3: presents the methodology of the study. Section 4: presents the results and discussion from the study. Section 5: summaries the finding and concludes with prospective future applications.

articleTitle: Doppler Frequency Shift and SNR Estimation using Improved STFT-based method for mmWave Wind Profiler Radar
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: When utilizing mmWave wind profiler radar (WPR) to estimate Doppler frequency shift and wind speed of the backscattered signals, the speed and power of wind turbulence are always inhomogeneous. During the interval of fast Fourier transform (FFT), multiple signals and noise may be received in a single FFT spectrum. The short time Fourier transform (STFT) can partially increase the temporal resolution and select signals by constant false alarm rate (CFAR), but will also lower the frequency resolution. To address that issue, an improved STFT-based method is proposed in this paper, which combines the STFT, interpolation, wavelet transform, and coherent accumulation to improve both temporal resolution and frequency resolution, and accurately estimate Doppler frequency shift and SNR. The proposed STFT-based method is applied to a 24 GHz wind profiler radar, and tested in the actual wind farm in Zhangbei, Hebei province, China. Compared to the FFT and STFT, the proposed method can estimate the Doppler frequency shift and wind speed more accurately.

Author Keywords: Doppler frequency shift and signal-to-noise-ratio (SNR) estimation

articleTitle: Analysis Of Feature Noise On Standard SVM With Linear Kernel
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Support Vector Machines (SVMs) with linear kernels have proven effective in classification tasks, especially when dealing with linearly separable datasets. However, real-world datasets often introduce challenges in the form of noise, impacting the model’s performance. This research systematically investigates the interplay between feature noise, hyperplane deviation, and the regularization parameter (C) in standard SVMs with linear kernels. Feature noise is introduced through controlled perturbations in input features, simulating uncertainties in real-world datasets. Simultaneously, hyperplane deviation, indicating the departure of the decision boundary from an ideal separation, is considered. Through a series of experiments, we explore the influence of varying C values on classification accuracies, aiming to provide insights into the adaptability and robustness of linear SVMs in the presence of feature noise and hyperplane deviation.

articleTitle: Plant Leaf Disease Detection Using Transfer Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Plant diseases are a significant hazard to feeding a growing population, but timely detection is challenging due to a lack of infrastructure in many world regions. Finding and detecting plant illness is essential in agricultural production. It takes a great deal of time and effort to find the disease. The agricultural sector can also reap the benefits of machine learning and deep learning. There has been a recent rise in the use of ML & DL techniques in plant disease identification. In this paper, we applied a transfer learning technique for plant disease prediction. We used a ‘plant village’ dataset with augmentation collected from Kaggle. This abstract presents a comprehensive plant leaf disease detection approach using transfer learning. The proposed method leverages pre-trained deep learning models to extract relevant features from plant leaf images, thereby enhancing the detection accuracy and reducing the need for extensive labelled data. The key components of this approach include data acquisition, pre-processing, model selection, and evaluation. The proposed approach was evaluated using various metrics, including accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score. The results demonstrated that transfer learning significantly enhanced the models’ ability to differentiate between healthy and diseased leaves, with high accuracy and reduced false positives. Moreover, the model’s ability to generalise across different plant species and disease types was assessed, highlighting its versatility.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Biometric Blockchain Authentication for VANET Security
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In the research paper titled "Design and Implementation of Biometric Blockchain Authentication for VANET Security," the authors propose a comprehensive solution to enhance the security of Vehicular Ad Hoc Networks (VANETs). By integrating biometric authentication with blockchain technology, the system offers a secure means of identifying and authenticating vehicles while ensuring tamper-resistant data storage and access control. The paper details the system's architecture, biometric data handling, and performance evaluation, including metrics such as Authentication Success Rate, False Acceptance Rate, and Transaction Throughput. Results show that the system effectively improves VANET security, with the potential to revolutionize connected transportation by addressing present security challenges and laying the foundation for a more secure transportation infrastructure.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach for Accurate Stock Market Forecasting by Integrating ARIMA and XGBoost
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In today's economy, the prediction and analysis of stock market data play a crucial role. Over the last decade, researchers have employed the neural network, an intelligent data mining technique, across various domains. Forecasting algorithms can be broadly classified into linear models and non-linear models. This paper employs the Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average (ARIMA) linear model to develop a robust predictive framework for forecasting stock market trends. This study introduces an innovative method by combining the ARIMA algorithm with XGBoost machine learning to create an advanced predictive model for stock market trends. By integrating temporal dependency capture from ARIMA with the improved predictive capabilities of the machine-learning model, this approach aims to enhance the accuracy and effectiveness of stock market trend predictions. Leveraging the strengths of both methodologies, the hybrid model exhibits superior accuracy, surpassing standalone ARIMA and XGBoost models. Training the model involves utilizing historical stock prices, trading volumes, and pertinent financial indicators. Evaluation will encompass the Google stock dataset to estimate the model's performance across various market conditions. By analyzing diverse historical stock market data, including prices, trading volumes, and financial indicators, the integrated model achieves a remarkable prediction accuracy of over 96.7%. The results underscore the efficacy of combining traditional time series analysis with advanced machine learning, positioning the ARIMA-XGBoost hybrid model as a potent tool for precise and robust stock market trend forecasting.

articleTitle: EchoSight: Blending Deep Learning and Computer Vision for Unparalleled Navigational Support for the Visually Impaired
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Our research aims to magnify mobility support for visually impaired individuals by introducing an innovative EchoSight fortified with computer vision and deep learning algorithms. Central to our design ethos is facilitating heightened independence for those often dependent on external help due to visual limitations. The EchoSight leverages the power of YOLOv3, faster CNN, and R-CNN for precise obstacle detection coupled with ultrasonic sensors. In a comparative analysis, our model demonstrated an impressive 95% accuracy rate in detecting distant obstacles, outperforming traditional aids that identify at a rate of only 70%. Furthermore, EchoSight effectively alerts users of these hazards through a multi-modal system consisting of vibration feedback, buzzer notifications, and an integrated voice assistant.
