publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) have gained significant importance in various fields, but their long-term sustainability is a challenge due to limited energy resources. One of the solutions to this issue can be energy-efficient cluster-based routing. This review explores various objectives and advantages of clustering which include load balancing, scalability, and robustness. It introduces a structured taxonomy categorizing routing protocols into hierarchical, fuzzy, and metaheuristic classifications. Hierarchical taxonomy emphasizes organizational structures, while fuzzy logic-based protocols use fuzzy reasoning for context-aware decisions in dynamic WSN environments. Metaheuristic-based protocols, inspired by nature-driven optimization techniques, optimize energy consumption and routing efficiency in WSNs. This research explores technical aspects, limitations, advantages, and potential future research directions in clustering-based routing protocols in WSNs.

articleTitle: Binary Classification of News Articles using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The proliferation of fake news has emerged as a substantial concern in the contemporary digital era. The advent of social media and online news platforms has significantly facilitated the dissemination of misinformation and propaganda. Consequently, there is a pervasive scepticism surrounding conventional news outlets, influencing political outcomes. Thus, it becomes imperative to devise robust strategies for the detection of fake news. In recent times, deep learning has proven to be a potent tool, particularly in the domain of natural language processing.This scholarly paper introduces an inventive deep learning-based methodology for identifying fake news. The proposed model integrates Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks, and the transformer-based model BERT to adeptly extract features from textual content within news articles. Through training on a substantial dataset of categorized news articles and evaluation using various metrics, the experimental outcomes compellingly affirm the effectiveness of the proposed approach in accurately discerning fake news, achieving high precision and recall rates. This methodology holds considerable promise in counteracting the proliferation of misinformation on social media and online news platforms

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Image Analysis for Precision Diagnosis and Recognition Using Cutting-Edge Visual Encoding
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This groundbreaking study introduces a revolutionary image analysis method, showcasing unprecedented accuracy in precision diagnosis and recognition. The innovative approach seamlessly integrates feature detection and description, demonstrating exceptional proficiency in identifying crucial local features. The advanced visual encoding architecture, surpassing conventional methods, utilizes intricate convolutional layers and the renowned Haar algorithm, achieving a remarkable 99% success rate. This comprehensive suite of advancements propels image analysis to new heights, with potential applications ranging from medical diagnostics to facial recognition. Strongly accepted for its cutting-edge techniques and impressive success rate.

articleTitle: Novel Fuzzy PID Control Tuning for a Chemical Process Control System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: PID is a widely used controller in the process industry. Tuning of PID controller is important for effective control of the system variables. However, PID-tuning is not easy for a complex system where disturbances are common phenomena. The proposed work employs the Fuzzy-PID tuning method for a chemical-process system. Responses have been observed in two cases, firstly when the system is normally working and secondly, when the system is subjected to some disturbance. The performance of the system is compared with some of the existing literature.

articleTitle: Design And Stability Analysis of Control Loops In Field Oriented Control of Traction PMSM Drives For EV Application
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This paper focuses on the design and stability analysis of control loops within the framework of field-oriented control (FOC) applied to traction permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) drives for electric driven vehicle (EVs). The proposed field-oriented control (FOC) technique is for controlling the traction motor which aims to improve dynamic and steady state performance of drive system. The key concept of this motor control technique is to obtain the linearized dynamics of PMSM similar to the dynamics of DC machine. The linear model of motor controller consists of three loops i.e., speed loop and two inner current loops. And the main objective of paper is to design the control scheme to achieve fast response and increase the overall efficiency of the system. The drive system is subjected to operate in three driving modes i.e., acceleration, cruising (constant speed) and deceleration mode along with variable loading condition to test the robust behaviour of system. The simulation results of model are verified in MATLAB-Simulink environment.

articleTitle: Biometric Authentication using lightweight Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Biometric technology like face recognition, retina scan and finger print mapping are very useful in identification and verification to recognize a person. In recent years, many deep learning algorithms have proposed for various applications specially face recognition. Hierarchical architecture of deep learning methods significantly improves the Face Recognition performance and encourages diverse and efficient real – world application. In Face Recognition Technology mainly four phases are exist: face detection, face alignment, feature extraction and classification. Many challenges are faced in face recognition like: pose, age, illumination, gender etc. Convolutional neural network (CNN) achieves good performance in face recognition system. In Deep learning especially convolutional neural network models required large data sets to train the deep layers and provide more accuracy. In CNN, Many models work for pattern recognition. One of them is Visual Geometry Group (VGG), which have large number of layers in architecture. In this research, light VGG – 16 models is proposed to recognize faces. The proposed model achieves good accuracy and low loss value in comparison to traditionally VGG -16 and comparatively reduces the number of parameters because large number of parameter takes significant memory size.

articleTitle: Mathematical Design and Numerical Optimization of additives in Transformer Oil using RSM CCD
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The addition of antioxidants to the Transformer Oil (TO) is increasingly important due to its benefits during the operation of transformers. Despite its excellent dielectric function, the liquid insulation deteriorates by temperature and moisture. The over-addition of antioxidants (Ax) leads to agglomeration and the less-addition leads to poor dielectric properties. However, to keep the Primary Ax (PriAx) and Preventive Ax (PreAx) in phase with the TO, this method uses an emulsifier and stabilizer called Lecithin (Ln). To find the optimal addition of additives this method uses Response Surface Method (RSM) – Central Composite Design (CCD). The overall proposed method mathematical designs and evaluate the generated models. The optimal solutions are obtained using numerical optimization attempt and thereby creating 2D design spaces. Hence, this method provides both desirability and credibility.

articleTitle: A Novel 1-bit Fast and Low Power 17-T Full Adder Circuit
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This proposed study shows a novel 1-bit fast and low-power 17-T XOR-XNOR Full adder circuit, a significant step forward in the field of digital circuit design. The XOR-XNOR circuit, which has been recognized as a vital component, has a significant impact on power consumption, driving capability, and latency—all essential aspects that directly influence the overall performance of the hybrid full adder. The proposed circuit is thoroughly tested using advanced modeling tools inside Cadence Virtuoso and advancing 45-nm CMOS technology. This analysis goes beyond the isolated circuit and explores its use in creating a functional design for arithmetic logic units (ALUs), which are essential parts of digital processors. This circuit's novel strength is in its ability to not only significantly reduce power consumption for digital processors but also to simultaneously eliminate latency, resulting in an optimal power-delay product.

articleTitle: Enhancing Efficiency and Effectiveness: An Innovative Design for Multipliers on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Multiplication is an essential arithmetic operation that is employed in many domains, including image processing and machine learning. Despite high-performance FPGA multiplier availability, restrictions exist - limited DSP blocks and locations reduce efficiency for smaller bit widths. This work emphasizes the need for better custom soft multiplier FPGA designs targeting improved speed and lower resource usage. This paper introduces innovative architectures for multipliers on FPGA, aiming to enhance performance and resource efficiency. Our proposed designs leverage FPGA features such as lookup tables [LUTs] and fast-carry chains. In comparison to existing solutions, the proposed accurate multiplier achieves a significant reduction in lookup table utilization, while the proposed approximate multiplier demonstrates improved efficiency in critical path delay [CPD]. Area, latency, and PDP performance metrics are being taken into consideration. The detailed analysis is carried out for 16x16 proposed multipliers in Vivado.

articleTitle: A Planar Monopole Antenna Designed for WiMax, WiFi, WLAN, and Ultra-Wideband Frequencies with a Half Moon-Slotted Ring Shape
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This paper explores the design of a half-moon ring-shaped planar monopole antenna for ultra-wideband applications across various frequency ranges. The prescribed slotted ring antenna is manufactured over the FR4 epoxy substrate. Copper material was used in designing the top patch and ground plane in this antenna. The geometric size specifications of the designed antenna are 35mm×30mm×1.6mm. The slotted ring antenna resonates at a frequency of 8.2 GHz. The designed half-moon ring antenna achieves a reflection coefficient of -38.09 dB at the resonant frequency of 8.2 GHz. The antenna has a bandwidth of -10dB that ranges from 2 GHz to 13.6 GHz. The specified slotted ring antenna attains a net gain of 3.844 dBi at the resonating frequency of 8.2 GHz. The antenna is able to obtain the highest gain of 6.87 dBi, which is achieved at 12.7 GHz. A transmission efficiency of 97.88% is also achieved by the designed antenna. The antenna is best suited for modern wireless communication applications.

articleTitle: A Dual-Band Glass-Based Transmissive Metasurface for Improving RF Transmission through Window
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In order to improve the ability of window glass to penetrate electromagnetic waves and the spectrum utilization efficiency in the 5G communication frequency band, a new type of transmissive metasurface with a double-layer design is proposed in this paper. On the premise of ensuring the original advantages of window glass on the residential building, the characteristic of glass to transmit electromagnetic waves is improved in both N78 and N79 bands, and it also has favorable angular stability for incident angles from 0° to 45°.

articleTitle: Dual Axis Solar Tracking System (DAST)
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Dual-axis smart solar tracking system which is to optimize photovoltaic (PV) panel orientation for maximum energy generation on a global scale. The system seamlessly integrates components, including a microcontroller, a Global Positioning System (GPS), an automated compass, and a gyro orientation sensor. This integration enables precise sun tracking with minimal power consumption. Weather forecasting as well as self cleaning of PV panels can also be integrated. The Solar tracking system offers a highly efficient and adaptable solution for maximizing PV panel performance worldwide. Its operation and minimal power usage make it an environmentally friendly and cost-effective choice for solar energy generation, further advancing the global adoption of renewable energy technologies.

articleTitle: DC/DC Boost Converter Control Using Levenberg-Marquardt (LM) Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In this paper, we discuss the application of a DC-DC boost converter control through Artificial Neural Networks (ANN). Traditionally, the small-signal linearized model near the operating point serves as the basis for the construction of the regular PI (proportional-integral) controller. As a result, the system's operating point model is altered, and the controller performance during starting, load changes, or reference changes is inadequate. By adhering to the standard model, the ANN is trained using Levenberg-Marquardt (LM) Algorithm to minimize the error function. The LM algorithm reduces the error of the system model with numerous parameters, which is a benefit of the ANN. The results of the simulation and experimental setup indicate that compared to conventional PI-based control the peak overshoot is reduced by 88.25% in ANN-based control of the boost converter.

articleTitle: Innovative Approach to Design High Speed And Power Effective Content Addressable Memory
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Memory functionality in modern computing systems is heavily dependent on speed and power. Operations such as parallel searches are carried out in content addressable memory to improve access times. For high-speed applications, Ternary Content-Addressable Memory, or (TCAM), has gained popularity. We reported the results of our design of a Ternary Content-Addressable memory subsystem using Binary and Ternary CAM, which we proposed in this study for high-speed search and performance. A 45nm 1.2V CMOS simulation demonstrates increased speed and reduced energy consumption, with a minimal number of control signals needed for TCAM.

articleTitle: Harnessing the Power of Nature: A Short Review of Renewable Energy Resources
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This short review article examines the ever-changing realm of renewable energy resources, investigating their wide-ranging implementations, technological progressions, and capacity to fundamentally transform the worldwide energy paradigm. The discourse covers widely recognized energy sources, including solar, wind, hydropower, biomass, and geothermal, emphasizing their respective impacts on sustainability. Additionally, the article examines a range of nascent technologies, including inventive solar solutions and progress in tidal and wave energy. The assessment highlights the transformative capacity of renewable energy but also recognizes enduring obstacles, such as grid integration and intermittent nature. Through a synthesis of current research and development endeavors, the review emphasizes the criticality of renewable energy in promoting a cleaner and more sustainable future and mitigating environmental impacts.

articleTitle: An In-Depth Analysis of Robustness to Noise in Soft Margin Support Vector Machines
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This study investigates the resilience of the Soft Margin Support Vector Machine (SVM) in the presence of noise. Soft Margin SVMs are well-known for their adaptability when dealing with datasets that challenge perfect linear separability. This in-depth analysis investigates the robustness of Soft Margin Support Vector Machines (SVMs) in the presence of noise within training data. Recognizing the paramount importance of SVMs in machine learning applications, especially in real-world scenarios where data may be inherently noisy, this study contributes to understanding the performance of soft margin formulations. Employing a carefully defined noise model, the evaluation explores various noise levels and types, employing standard metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall and F1-Score. The experimental setup involves diverse datasets and systematically tuned SVM parameters. Results reveal the response of soft margin SVMs to different noise conditions,

articleTitle: Electrical Load Demand Forecast for Gujarat State of India using Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The work is concentrates on forecasting electrical loads of Gujarat state of India. Day ahead load demand forecasting is proposed by utilizing historical load demand data from year 2022 to 2023. The dataset, acquired for these years, are processed using Python scripts to filter and organize the information with a 15-minute timestamp granularity. Subsequently, Regression based machine learning algorithms are applied on Load Demand data of Gujarat to forecast day ahead load demand. The proposed work involves a comparative analysis of the performance of Linear Regression, Support Vector Regression and Regression Tree algorithms with their classes models, to enhance accuracy and efficiency in load forecasting. The results are evaluated based on metrics such as Mean Absolute Error (MAE) and Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) The Robust Linear Regression model outperforms all the classes with MAE 70.252 MW of and MAPE of 0.176%. This research aims to contribute valuable insights for making decision in the power sector by offering a refined and effective methodology for load prediction, potentially saving significant resources for utility companies.

articleTitle: Switching Transients Reduction for Battery Charging Controller during Mode Selection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In this paper, a modified battery charge controller has been discussed. The importance of batteries has been increasing commercially as well as industrially. The growth in the EV sector demands a better and more efficient battery to power the vehicles. A buck-boost converter is used to interface the battery with the source or load. This paper discusses the various charging and discharging modes of a battery. CC/CV charging methods are one of the most traditional and widely used methods for battery charging. But sometimes it is observed that transients are high during the transition from CC to CV mode. Hence, in addition to current and voltage control, an SOC estimation-based controller has been introduced. This proposed control strategy has been tested for reducing transients using the mode selection technique. For SOC estimation, the Kalman filter method is used for better response.

articleTitle: Real Time Fire Detection with Simple Thermal Imaging: A Novel Integration of Threshold and Change Detection Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This research study aims to develop a system, for imaging and fire detection by exploring the integration of the ESP32 microcontroller and AMG8833 thermal sensor for image processing. The ESP32 microcontroller is chosen for its power consumption, wireless connectivity and adaptability which simplifies the integration of sensors. The AMG8833 thermal sensor with its 8x8 array of sensors makes thermal imaging more accessible. Our proposed solution leverages the capabilities of the ESP32 to collect and transmit data from the AMG8833 sensor in time for monitoring and analysis purposes. Python is utilized as a programming language to facilitate image processing and implement fire detection systems. By combining these technologies we can create a rather cost effective solution for imaging and fire detection applications. The outcomes of this study lay a foundation for developing reliable systems that advance imaging and fire detection technology. Moreover this combination of ESP32, AMG8833 and Python opens up prospects for research and development in areas such as IoT (Internet of Things) and smart sensing applications.

articleTitle: A Technique to Optimize Clock Latency after CCOpt exploiting Useful Skew
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: A crucial phase in the physical design flow is clock tree synthesis (CTS). CTS constructs the clock tree by balancing the skew throughout the design for every clock present. Because of the shifting technology nodes and the resulting increased complexity of integrated circuits, the traditional flow of CTS during CCOpt is inefficient in many places. The analysis of effective CTS methods for the best timing convergence in SoC implementation is the main goal of this work. Exploiting useful skew and manual modification of buffer chain in clock path are the approaches used for clock delay reduction to enhance device performance.

articleTitle: Cyclone Intensity Estimation Leveraging Graph Convolution Recurrent Networks and INSAT 3D Imagery
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Tropical cyclone (TC) estimating includes storm surge forecast and concentrated location. Forecast and discovery of TC(Tropical Cyclone) concentration is critical and it plays down misfortune of life and various harms. Fast-spinning cyclones known as tropical cyclone winds are distinguished by weight, low-level climatic winds, and large amounts of precipitation. This may lead to common catastrophes, fatalities, and property harm. Coordinate estimations of winds inside tropical tornados are scanty, particularly over the open sea. INSAT is one of the various geostationary satellites claimed by India. INSAT stands for Indian National Satellite System, and ISRO propelled this multipurpose Geostationary satellite to meet India's requests to look and protect operations as well as broadcast communications and broadcasting.

articleTitle: Variational-AutoEncoder Siamese Network for Change Detection on Satellite Imagery
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Capturing changes in certain areas has assumed huge importance due to both man-made and natural phenomenon. Our novel research is aimed at urban classification using an unsupervised Variational Auto-encoder based Siamese network model for change detection on satellite imagery. It works well on Polarimetric Synthetic Aperture Radar (PolSAR) images of Uninhabited Aerial Vehicle Synthetic Aperture Radar (UAVSAR) as well as optical satellite images. The model encodes the images to get the latent feature vectors, on which the Siamese difference is performed and the resultant latent space is decoded to get the difference image. The metrics which help us determine how well our model predicts the mask are the recall score and the receiver operating characteristic curve. We have archived a recall score of 0.87 and the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve is 0.98

articleTitle: Predictive Modeling for Restaurant Menu Customization: An FP-Growth Algorithm-Based Solution
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Customizing the eating experience through personalized food recommendations has become crucial in the dynamic restaurant industry. Conventional recommendation systems often struggle to meet individual preferences and ordering patterns. The problem of analyzing and processing the huge amount of historical transactional data to offer tailored food recommendations that align with individual tastes and preferences is still a challenging task. This paper proposes an innovative solution to forge a resilient Food Recommendation Engine framework that would be able to make prediction as a set of five items as recommendation for each sold item of the restaurant. The proposed framework leverages the FP-Growth algorithm as a base algorithm to generate the frequent itemset and association rules for both item and its item category. Over the base algorithm was systematically evaluated across distinct meal categories with different support and confidence threshold and we combined a business-driven filtering rules and a custom prediction algorithm that has capabilities to make prediction on the sold item as recommendation based on the associations rules and frequent itemset obtained for both item and its category from the Fp-Growth. The prediction algorithm also provides some placeholder for adding items as advertisements to facilitate promotions. The generated food recommendation contains the combination of foods and beverages which results the total combination of five items per sold item for each part of the day meal including some placeholders. This research covers the complete framework development process, including data preparation, fp-Growth algorithm implementation, business-driven filtering rules and prediction algorithm design to generate recommendation item lists for each mealtime.

articleTitle: Design, Modeling, and Analysis of a Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor (PMSM) for Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: High performance vehicle designs require precise electric vehicle powertrain modeling, simulation, and validation. This paper describes a methodology for designing and evolving EV powertrains using MATLAB/Simulink software with comprehensive analysis of the results. It is well known that simulation of electric vehicles powertrains in software simulation is a substantial part of the design and improvement process, but it is equally important to validate these models on a practical vehicle system in directive to increase the reliability, safety and performance parameters of the electrical vehicle. The modeling methodology employed in this study leverages the application of MATLAB SIMULIK software in order to model and simulate an electric vehicle powertrain, along with the validation of the modeling results and analysis of an electric vehicle. That is being tested on different parameters at the same time. Combining these modeling techniques with practical validation establishes a cost effective method of rapidly emerging and endorsing high-performance electric vehicles, satisfying a gap in the literature regarding how these demonstrating practices can be applied to research. Vehicle models generate torque and power based on velocity input from the drive cycle. Using this torque as input constant parameter torque, the permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) model produces torque as well as power. Based on the simulated outcomes of the electrical vehicle prototype, analytical calculations are used to validate the simulated results. Analysis of vehicle different parameters with variations in preference angle and different driving cycle is also conducted. Using this prototype, we are able to measure different parameters of electrical vehicle.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Study of Epilepsy through Power Spectral Density, Katz Fractal Dimension, and Shannon Entropy
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Epilepsy is a neuropathological condition characterized by recurrent seizures, usually diagnosed by Electroencephalography (EEG). However, EEG signals are non- stationary and non-linear, necessitating the detection of potential early biomarkers. In this study, eight subjects with intractable epilepsy were chosen. The signals were denoised using wavelet transform. EEG signal features were extracted using a combination of Spectral analysis of the Delta-Theta ratio and Alpha-Beta ratio, Katz Fractal Dimension (KFD), and Shannon Entropy(SE). The variation of these features during normal, pre-ictal, ictal, and post-ictal phases was studied. Results show that non-linear features outperform linear features in characterizing neural changes during different stages of epilepsy. Shannon entropy could distinguish between normal and ictal phases; however, KFD can effectively characterize neural changes during the pre-ictal phase and be considered a potential early detection method for epilepsy.

articleTitle: Improved Semi Supervised Image Classification using GAN
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Image classification is the process of categorizing images into one or more pre-defined classes or categories based on the visual content of the image. The goal of image classification is to create a model that can accurately predict the class of an input image that it has not seen before. In this paper, a semi-supervised model has been proposed for image classification that uses Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) that can give excellent results using only few labelled training data.

articleTitle: Hyperparameter Tuned Cloud Based Cyber Physical Attack Detection using Stacking Ensemble Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The primary goal of this study is to analyze cyber-physical attacks on critical networks and to examine the operation of the cyber-physical system (intrusion detection system) and how hyperparameter-tuned ML models model are used to detect these attacks. Critical infrastructure, such as SCADA, WADI, and other remote control systems, require an advanced security solution to properly detect abnormalities and intrusions and safeguard data from malicious actors. The number of incursions in the modern era is rising significantly as a result of the fast expansion of linked devices, or "edge devices", which are open to assault. In this paper, we examine various machine learning techniques and apply stacking ensemble learning for our suggested approach. Next, we employ the hyperparameter tuning technique to enhance the model’s overall accuracy and performance. With our model, we have achieved 96.65% accuracy in the BATADAL dataset.

articleTitle: IoT and Machine Learning-Based Smart Soil Irrigation Farming Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Traditional agriculture is under pressure to provide more food with fewer resources due to a growing global population and environmental issues. Maximizing crop productivity and quality requires efficient water management, precise nutrient delivery, and ideal environmental conditions. Traditional methods are imprecise, wasting water, over-fertilizing, and causing poor growth. This initiative tackles the real-world demand for a revolutionary agriculture that maximizes resource efficiency, minimizes environmental damage, and secures food sustainability. Advanced technologies like the ESP32 WROOM Dev Kit, TDS sensor, DHT11 humidity sensor, REES52 soil moisture sensor, piezo mist module, LDR module, 4-channel relay module, and water and fertilizer motors enable automated and precise irrigation, fertilization, cooling, and sunlight exposure. Using real- time soil moisture data from the REES52 sensor, a smart irrigation technique is developed.

articleTitle: Object Detection in Traffic Videos
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In recent times, there has been an increase in demand in the automobile industry, particularly in driverless cars. The vehicles should automatically detect the objects and make decisions very fast, roughly in a span of milliseconds, without human intervention. The task of detecting objects contains several operations like object classification of live or non-live objects, detection, and position estimation from the source. This work focuses on detecting objects in traffic videos. Using YOLO5 model, predicted the locations, size, and confidence scores of potential places where an object can be in real time videos.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Potato Farming: A CNN-Powered Approach for Early Blight and Late Blight Detection to Ensure Global Food Security
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Potato, a crucial global food crop, faces persistent threats from diseases like early blight and late blight, jeopardizing both yields and economic stability. In response, we present an innovative approach using CNN for early disease detection in potato crops. Our objective is to empower farmers with rapid and accurate disease identification, facilitating timely treatments to prevent economic losses and reduce agricultural waste. Our CNN model achieved a remarkable validation accuracy of 99.59%, outperforming conventional methods. With 183,747 trainable parameters, our efficient and accurate model is set to revolutionize agricultural practices. Furthermore, we are deploying our model to Google Cloud and developing a React Native mobile app for potato prediction. This integration aims to provide farmers with real-time disease insights, preventing economic losses and ensuring global food security, thereby enhancing economic stability in the potato farming sector.

articleTitle: Web Based Password Management System For Robust Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Now a days technology is being used very often to do many things and it has changed the way of living today, which makes the generation of websites increase rapidly, which can access that company or organisation. To login to these websites username and password is required and it has been found that many people forget their passwords which something is very common. To prevent this, a website can be designed where people are be able to save their username, password, and the website link so that there will be no need to memorize it. This study also discusses about why use of a password manager and how it can build a password manager using HTML, JavaScript and CSS. Furthermore, this study discusses some misconceptions regarding password managers about privacy and security issues and gives a brief description for making an appealing interface for all users.

articleTitle: Utilisation of wavelet entropy on EEG as an assistive tool to detect ischemic damage in brain
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Focal cerebral ischemia, a neurological condition characterized by restricted blood supply to a specific area of the brain, presents a significant challenge in terms of diagnosis and treatment. Wavelet entropies are applied to assess ischemic damage in the frontoparietal, occipital, and temporal lobes of male Foster rats subjected to induced ischemia and treated with the piroxicam drug. Experimental findings highlight the high sensitivity of Shannon entropy in detecting ischemic damage in the brain, particularly at the eighth scale. Shannon and Rényi entropies exhibit high sensitivity in identifying ischemic damage across theta and alpha EEG bands in the three lobes, as well as in the frontoparietal and occipital lobes across the beta EEG band during both ischemic and recovery stages. However, Shannon entropy fails to identify ischemic damage in the frontoparietal and temporal lobes across the delta EEG band. Shannon and Rényi entropies have the potential to serve as supplementary tools for physicians in identifying ischemic damage in the brain, providing valuable insights that could enhance diagnostic and treatment strategies for ischemic patients.

articleTitle: IoT-based Battery Health Monitoring and Its Remaining Useful Life Prediction using Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Electric vehicles nowadays face issues with battery downgrading and sometimes explosions. The predictive maintenance and preventive alerts for hazardous situations regarding batteries will help the user take necessary actions. In this study, the condition of a Lithium-ion battery was monitored on the ThingSpeak cloud platform using an Internet of Things setup. An Artificial Neural Network (ANN) model was developed using NASA’s battery dataset for discharge cycles. The model was used for predicting the Remaining Useful Life (RUL) of a battery at its current operating cycle number. The study showed degradation in battery capacity over a no, of cycles. The trained ANN model was able to predict the RUL of a battery before its End of Life (EoL).

articleTitle: Drive For Switched Reluctance Motor Using An Asymmetric Bridge Converter: A TopDown Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: A Switched Reluctance Motor with its high starting torque, high efficiency, simple speed control, and the lack of any back EMF makes it an excellent option for electric vehicles but the need for position and current sensing and its nonlinear inductance profile makes driving it a challenge. In this paper, various converter designs are investigated to drive the motor and a comparison is carried out between R-Dump, C Dump, and Asymmetric bridge converters where asymmetric bridge converter was deemed suitable to carry out further work. Using a MOSFET as the switching element and an ATmega328p microcontroller for control, an asymmetric bridge converter is constructed utilizing AS5600 and ACS712 to sense position and current.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of System Protection Scheme for Interlinking Transformers at Thermal Power Station
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This research paper designed a system protection scheme (SPS) for two 400kV/220kV interlinking transformer (ILT) installed on thermal power plant (TPP) of a practical utility grid to make these ILTs N-1 compliant. Two SPS logic are designed to avoid tripping of ILTs from the overload conditions and to avoid tripping of one ILT when another ILT is tripped on fault. This is achieved by load curtailment on the nearby 220 kV Grid-substation (GSS) in the region. The overload command taken from over-load/over-current relay and trip command taken from 86-master trip relay of the ILTs is transmitted over power line carrier communication (PLCC) system to the nearby 220 kV GSS to trip the 220kV/132kV transformers for load curtailment to reduce loading on the ILTs at TPP. SPS logic are validated through load flow studies performed on Rajasthan transmission system using MiPower software. The designed SPS is effective to avoid cascade tripping of transformers in a power grid which helps to prevent the large area from dark and also ensure proper power evacuation from a thermal power plant.

articleTitle: Electrostatic Performance Enhanced in a Graded Doped Junctionless Gate All Around MOSFET
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In this article analysis the Graded doped Junctionless Gate All Around (GD-JGAA) MOSFETs and find that the electrostatic performance of the proposed devices GD-JGAA and compared to the JGAA MOSFET. As a result, find that the SS and DIBL are minimum in GD-JGAA MOSFET. So that the SCEs are reduced in GD-JGAA MOSFET as compared to JGAA MOSFET. Also find that the subthreshold current (IOFF) is minimal as well as the ION current also reduced. As a result, the ION/IOFF current ratio improved. So that the power delay performance increased in GD-JGAA MOSFET. So, that the device GD-JGAA MOSFET is most suitable for digital applications.

articleTitle: Optimizing Power Grid Operations with IoT-Based Distribution Transformer Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The paper discusses the development of a control and monitoring system for distribution transformers using IoT-based solutions. The Indian power grid is one of the largest in the world and is rapidly expanding, creating a complex mesh network. The existing SCADA system provides data to the system operator for steady-state operation, but there is a need for real-time data at the distribution level. Distribution transformers are the heart of the electrical grid, and monitoring them is crucial to prevent power outages. The proposed system uses IoT and embedded systems to monitor electrical parameters such as voltage, current, and power, and sends telemetry data to a gateway that accumulates data from other nodes and relays it to the substation. The system also includes a local dashboard for each substation and an upper layer central dashboard that collectively displays data from all substations. The system follows a three-layer architecture, with sensing nodes attached to transformers measuring electrical parameters and transmitting data to the gateway using communication modules. The communication layer processes, stores, and connects to the application layer, where the data is displayed on dashboards and can be shared with upper levels and other legacy systems using APIs with real time monitoring using MQTT and Node-RED.

articleTitle: DNA Sequence Binding to specified Protein Strutcure and Classification by using CNN and k-mer Encoding Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: One of the most important tasks in a general computational framework for biomedical data analysis is the categorization of DNA sequences. Several machine learning techniques have been used in recent years to successfully complete this job. In any case, the feature selection procedure continues to be the primary source of difficulties for the issue. Sequences lack explicit characteristics, and the primary issue of high dimensionality is introduced by the generally employed representations. It is true that machine learning techniques for supervised classification problems heavily rely on the feature extraction stage, and that important aspects of the objects to be classified must be identified and measured in order to construct a suitable representation. Neural deep learning architectures, often known as deep learning models, have demonstrated the ability to automatically extract meaningful features from input patterns. Two distinct encoding techniques—k-mer and label encoding, are presented as input to the suggested model of CNN classification along with embedded layer to represent DNA sequences. When compared to various encoding techniques, the suggested CNN hybrid model with label encoding had the better classification accuracy, at 97.22%

articleTitle: Wind Speed Estimation Using FRFT-Based Method for mmWave Wind Profiler Radar in Low SNR Conditions
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: When utilizing mmWave wind profiler radar (WPR) to detect wind speed in low signal-to-noise-ratio (SNR) conditions, increasing the No. of coherent accumulation (COACC) is an effective way to increase the SNR, but will also lead to a longer beam period. In a long period, the velocity of wind or clutters cannot be regarded as constant and the acceleration of targets will cause spectrum overlap. In this paper, we propose a wind speed estimation method based on fractional Fourier transform (FRFT) to solve the spectrum overlap problem, estimate the Doppler shift of received signal in the 2-D FRFT domain, and calculate the wind speed of backscattered turbulent echoes. The proposed FRFT-based method is applied to a 24 GHz wind profiler radar in the Zhangbei wind farm of Hebei province, China. In the local wind farm, the results of the proposed method show good match with the meteorology mast in low SNR conditions.

articleTitle: Design, Simulation and Analysis of Electric Vehicle Drive
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This paper undertakes a comprehensive investigation into electric vehicle (EV) drive systems, emphasizing design, simulation, and analysis to elevate performance and efficiency. A noteworthy aspect of this study lies in the incorporation of tailored models, introducing a novel approach to optimize EVs across a spectrum of environmental and infrastructure conditions. We initiate our inquiry by systematically classifying electric vehicles and scrutinizing market-specific models, setting the stage for a multifaceted exploration.The novelty of our research resides in the utilization of advanced simulation techniques to model various drive system architectures. This allows us to meticulously analyze a diverse array of performance parameters under varying operational scenarios, shedding light on the intricacies of EV behavior. Furthermore, our approach introduces tailored models, a pioneering method aimed at fine-tuning EV performance based on specific conditions such as topography, climate, and infrastructure availability. This study’s significance extends beyond a theoretical examination; it offers practical insights for researchers, engineers, and policymakers engaged in the evolution of sustainable transportation. The inclusion of visual representations enhances the accessibility of complex technical information, ensuring that the findings contribute effectively to the ongoing discourse on optimizing electric vehicle drive systems for a cleaner, more efficient future.

articleTitle: "Event Evolution- A Modern Approach To Timeless Celebration"
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The event management system is a valuable tool that allows organizations to effectively maintain client engagement, even when clients are on the move. In today's fast-paced and technologically advanced world, the online platform has emerged as the preferred medium for accessing various services. Recognizing this trend and the need to adapt to changing consumer behavior, this proposal aims to develop a comprehensive event management system that encompasses the entire process of planning and coordinating events.Event planning involves a multitude of tasks and responsibilities, all of which need to be carefully managed to ensure the success of an event. These tasks include budgeting, scheduling, event selection, obtaining necessary permits, coordinating transportation and parking, arranging for speakers or entertainers, organizing decor, ensuring event security, managing catering services, collaborating with third-party vendors, and establishing emergency plans. All of these requirements will be taken into consideration during the design and development of the event management system.

articleTitle: HOMER GRID; Study and optimization of utility grid HRES system for remote area in India
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In this study, utility grid a solar and wind based hybrid power system is developed for remote area of Madhya Pradesh India. HOMER GRID software was used to develop a simulation model for remote area Surajpura (latitude 23° 50' 20.5944'' N, longitude 79° 26' 27.6900'' E) in Jabera Tehsil in Damoh district of Madhya Pradesh. []. The inputs used in the simulation include real solar radiation data and wind speed data (average monthly rates), taken from the NREL radiation.

articleTitle: Design of Isolated Flyback Transformer for 50-200 kHz switching frequency range
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This paper presents the design methodology and optimization techniques employed in developing an isolated flyback transformer suitable for a switching frequency range of 50-200kHz.The study investigates the methodology of transformer design, taking into account factors such as core material selection, winding configurations. This methodology also involves several calculations. By employing several calculations, the proposed methodology aims to achieve efficient energy transfer, minimal losses, and reliable operation within the specified frequency range. For our application that requires delivering an average output power of 50 Watt, a choke filter is used instead of a power transformer. The purpose that we used the transformer is to provide an isolation between primary side and secondary side, which is mainly required by safety standards for electronic devices. Hence, the transformer magnetizing inductance is designed to be more in this type of transformer, to be able to store some amount of energy.

articleTitle: Optimizing Substation Earthing Systems: A Finite Difference Approach for Grounding Resistance Minimization and Potential Distribution Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Substation earthing is a critical aspect of power system design, playing a crucial role in ensuring safety and reliability. This paper presents an in-depth numerical analysis of substation earthing systems, employing the finite difference method. The primary objectives are to optimize grounding resistance and gain insights into the electric potential distribution within the earthing mat. This research systematically explores key parameters, including earthing mat dimensions, material conductivity, and soil resistivity, employing visualizations such as scatter plots, contour plots, and quiver plots to enhance the understanding of the earthing system behaviour. This optimal design helps in getting values of ground resistance, quite fast and with more ease.

articleTitle: Faster Mimic and Fool: An Adversarial Attack
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Currently, adversarial attacks are typically designed for specific tasks, and although there are some task-agnostic attacks are generally less effective than task-specific ones. These attacks exploit the fact that CNN-based feature extractors cannot be reversed or inverted, making the downstream models vulnerable to these attacks. However, they are not optimally designed because they use the entire CNN to generate an adversarial example. This paper proposes a modified version of this approach called Faster Mimic and Fool (MaF), which requires less time and fewer resources to create an adversarial image. The experiment involved selecting 100 random FlickR 8K images and testing the attack on an Inception-V3-based captioning model. The results showed that Faster MaF achieved a Bleu-4 score that is 13.5% and 31.1% better than MaF and OIMO, respectively. Since Faster MaF requires knowledge of the CNN, it can be considered a grey-box attack.

articleTitle: Automation in fruit ripening through Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: One popular fruit grown and consumed worldwide is the mango. Currently, mangoes are manually sorted based on their ripeness level for commercial purposes, leading to inaccuracies and increased labor costs in the processing sector. An alternative method proposed involves using visual characteristics to categorize mangoes, with Badami mangoes used as a case study. This approach can be applied to any variety of mango that undergoes color changes during ripening. By analyzing the average gray-scale values of pixels in images and developing algorithms using Python programming with Open-Source Computer Vision Library, it was found that there is a significant shift in gray-scale values during mangos' ripening process. When compared with manual results, this technique demonstrated an accuracy rate of 90.90%, assuming ambient lighting conditions when capturing images.

articleTitle: Cognitive Computing’s Role in Shaping the Future Landscape of Healthcare
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: As the healthcare industry undergoes a paradigm shift towards data-driven and patient-centric models, cognitive computing emerges as a transformative force. This research paper delves into the profound impact of cognitive computing on the future landscape of healthcare. Through an extensive review of literature, case studies and emerging trends, this paper explores the applications, benefits, challenges, and ethical considerations associated with integrating cognitive computing into healthcare practices. Drawing on interdisciplinary perspectives, we examine how cognitive computing enhances diagnostic precision, optimizes treatment plans, facilitates personalized medicine, and improves overall healthcare delivery. The paper also scrutinizes the ethical implications of leveraging cognitive computing in healthcare, considering issues such as data privacy, bias, and the human-machine interface. By synthesizing existing knowledge and proposing future research directions, this paper contributes to the ongoing discourse on the role of cognitive computing in shaping the trajectory of healthcare.

articleTitle: A Super-wide band DGS based Circularly Polarized Wearable Antenna for S-band, C-band, X-band & Ku-band Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: A low-profile, super-wide band circularly polarized (CP) wearable textile antenna has been presented in this manuscript which operates in S, C, X & Ku-band. The dimensions of the antenna are 50×52×2.04mm3 and it is fed by a 50Ω microstrip line by inset feeding technique. The ground is partially defected to improve the impedance bandwidth (IBW) and the edges of the rectangular patch are chamfered to provide circular polarization. The IBW is 123.618% (3.78GHz-16GHz) and the average gain is 3.75dBi throughout the operating bandwidth. It provides dual bands of axial ratio bandwidth (ARBW) with lower band of 0.339GHz (5.625GHz-5.964GHz) and upper band of 0.541GHz (12.793-13.335GHz). The antenna is suitable for telemedicine (Industrial Scientific & Medical-band), 5G communication, defense applications (X-band), satellite communication (Ku-band) and allied technologies. The prototype has been fabricated for experimental validation.

articleTitle: A Short Review on the Key Indicators of Ageing Studies Conducted on Insulating Oil
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Having known by the facts on the ageing studies on insulating oil, it is ever important to know the key indicators encompassed within this. One of the crucial things in ageing study is to map the relevant parameters with the method which it is related to. Here, in this short review however insightful way is to relate the outcomes of depolymerization of paper insulation during the ageing process on various insulating fluids. In this context, the indicators besieged in the content provides not only a foreknowledge but also details of ageing method adopted, key properties, target application, standards used, special tests and software used. Overall, these data serve as a package to develop new concepts in ageing studies on insulating fluids. The scope for the future research encompasses with state-of-the-art method to improve the speed of analysis via comprehensive tools. This applies to insulating oils used in both the Power Transformer (PT) and the Distribution Transformer (DT).

articleTitle: Fabrication and Database Management of Cubesat
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The continuous evolution of technology necessitates the creation of cutting-edge innovations for the betterment of mankind. One remarkable achievement that emerged in 1999 is the concept of CubeSats, drastically reducing the cost of satellite development and launch, leading to numerous space experiment applications. CubeSats have emerged as a groundbreaking solution in the realm of satellite technology, comprising modular cubic units, each measuring 10cm x 10cm x 10cm. This standardized form factor enables unparalleled flexibility in design, empowering researchers and institutions to customize CubeSats for diverse missions. This paper presents the conceptualization and development of a CubeSat equipped with an advanced environmental parameter sensing system, including temperature, pressure, humidity, altitude, accelerometer, and gyroscope. The collected data is efficiently stored in a centralized XAMMP database management system, functioning as a compact ground station server. With externally mounted antennas and a dedicated onboard microcontroller, the CubeSat boasts an innovative local database system, offering unparalleled features. These CubeSats offer an affordable means of implementing coordinated sensing, low-bandwidth communications, and efficient local database management. The cost-effective local database management server provides compelling evidence that local database systems are a viable and dependable means of storing and maintaining mission-critical data for cube satellites. By showcasing the potential of small-scale satellite projects, this development empowers individuals and educational institutions to participate in hands-on space exploration, fostering creativity and inspiring future generations of space enthusiasts.

articleTitle: Smart Restaurant Management System using LABVIEW
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)

articleTitle: Reduced Switch Count Asymmetrical Seven-Level Inverter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The idea of a multilayer inverter originates from the extension of inverters to over two layers in order to lessen distortion from the basic sinusoidal waveform. The drawback of using multiple level inverter is inclusion of extra switches that makes the system bulkier and costly and the reliability of the system reduces due to increment in count of components. In this art, a seven level inverter is presented with reduced number of switches as compared to symmetrical H-bridged seven level inverter. The idea is built on MATLAB platform and results are analysed to verify its utility.

articleTitle: Detection and Classification of Faults in AC Microgrids based on Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The incorporation of renewable energy sources and the increasing intricacy of microgrid systems are intertwined developments underscore the need for robust fault detection mechanisms to ensure reliable and stable operation. This research focuses on the application of wavelet transform for fault detection in a 5-bus microgrid system. The wavelet transform, recognized for its capacity to examine signals in both temporal and frequency domains, is employed to capture transient behaviors indicative of faults. Transmission lines are crucial components of power systems responsible for the efficient and reliable transfer of electricity over long distances. Yet their seamless operation can be hindered by various faults and disruptions. This paper proposes a novel approach to identify faults for microgrid leveraging wavelet-based analysis. The scheme aims to enhance fault detection accuracy by harnessing the capabilities of wavelet transform to provide valuable insights into both temporal and frequency domains. The proposed scheme begins by collecting data from various sensors within the microgrid, capturing critical parameters such as voltage, current, and frequency. Raw data is often noisy and requires preprocessing to optimize signal quality. Wavelet transform is subsequently utilized to break down the signal into its constituent frequencies components across multiple scales. This decomposition enables the extraction of distinctive features that signify anomalies caused by faults or disturbances. In light of the foregoing, this work intends to investigate the use of wavelet-based fault detection in microgrids, highlighting its advantages, difficulties, and potential to improve power grid performance as a whole.

articleTitle: Improving Solar Power Efficiency: A Comparison of MPPT Methods with a Focus on Hybrid ANNP&O Controller
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Solar energy holds significant potential in India, with a growing application across various sectors. In photovoltaic (PV) systems, capturing solar energy successfully is crucial. PV modules exhibit nonlinear trends in response to various irradiance and temperature conditions, making it crucial to operate them at their maximum power point (MPP) for most fulfilling performance. This paper provides a smart ANN-P&O MPPT controller for boost converters in PV structures, aiming to enhance power efficiency via optimizing the maximum power issue. It compares this method with conventional MPPT methods (IC and P&O) through simulations in MATLAB/SIMULINK, highlighting the controller's effectiveness in diverse conditions.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study on Diabetic Retinopathy Datasets for Data Accuracy Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Diabetic retinopathy is a problem that affects diabetics' eyes. It has the potential to cause vision loss by affecting the small blood vessels in the rear of the eye as well as Diabetic retinopathy is difficult to detect and comprehend. Dataset 1 [15] had the highest accuracy of 0.74, followed by Dataset 3 [17] at 0.72, and Dataset 2 [16] had the lowest accuracy of 0.68.
