Knowing about and tackling these issues are the most important first steps.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of NN based MPPT Algorithms for PV-Boost Converter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The output across solar is based upon the solar irradiance falling on the PV-plate. The irradiances are fluctuating in nature, so does the output power of the solar. Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) is used for tracking the maximum point of voltage and current generation at any instant from PV-array. This helps in obtaining the maximum power output from solar at any value of irradiance. The efficiency of the MPPT can be improved several times by optimizing its parameters of variations using any intelligent technique. This paper considers Perturb and Observe (P&O) as well as Incremental and Conductance (I&C) MPPT whose output is optimized using Neural Network (NN) based AI technique. DC-DC converter is designed to regulate the output voltage of the PV module in buck/boost mode as per the need. A single switch unidirectional topology is opted for designing the DC-converter whose gate pulses are controlled via NN based MPPT algorithm. A comparative analysis is presented for P&O and I&C algorithm with and without NN technique. The results are obtained in MATLAB software for simulink to validate the topology proposed.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Sub-carrier Assignment Algorithms for Three-Users in MC-NOMA System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Non-Orthogonal Multiple Access (NOMA) is widely recognized as a vital technology for next-generation wireless networks, primarily due to its significant advantages in Spectral Efficiency (SE) and ensuring user fairness. In this paper, various Sub-carrier Assignment Algorithms (SAA) are explored to understand their functioning, and their performance is evaluated in terms of SE, user fairness, and computational complexity, focusing on a scenario with three users sharing a single sub-channel. Previously, all these existing SAA performances were evaluated by employing two users within the sub-channel. The simulation results show that the Spectral Efficiency Maximization (SEM) algorithm gives superior performance in SE in the context of three users per sub-carrier. Conversely, the Worst-Case User First Sub-carrier Allocation (WCUFSA) algorithm is the top performer for fairness considerations. Regarding computational complexity, the Worst Sub-carrier First (WSF) algorithm proves more efficient than the existing SAA.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Image Enhancement Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: A crucial aspect of image processing is image enhancement. Image enhancement techniques can be used to improve the image's quality and aesthetic appeal in order to more accurately convey a transform. In general, multiple types of photos, including satellite images, medical images, and photographs taken in real life, are impacted by low contrast and unique noise. A picture can be enhanced or modified using the filtering process. For instance, we may filter an image to highlight some elements while removing others. Filtering is used to accomplish image processing operations including edge enhancement, sharpening, and smoothing. Image enhancement, filtering, segmentation etc. all are considered in image preprocessing.

articleTitle: Medical Drug Analysis using graph neural network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Understanding the complex relationships between medicinal drugs is of paramount importance and is a challenge with the rapid development of new drugs. In this paper Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are used to analyze drugs in a new way. Realizing that drug molecules naturally look like graphs, with atoms as nodes and bonds as lines, this work uses the power of GNNs to get both local and global information from the molecular structures. GNN analyzes complex patterns and relationships, which gives more information about how drugs interact with each other, what side effects they might have, and how they work. Comparing GNN-based approach to traditional ways of analyzing drugs, it is observed that GNN networks analyses is better at predicting drug properties, drug-drug interactions, and chances for repurposing drugs. This study demonstrates how GNNs could change the way drug analysis is done and also paves the way for more thorough, efficient, and accurate ways to find new drugs in the future.

articleTitle: Optimizing Solar Power Generation with Bidirectional Converter and Fuzzy Logic for Battery Management in EVs
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The paper investigates the efficacy of fuzzy logic control based MPPT of a solar module scheme under unfavorable atmospheric situations and associated with load needs. The solar PV module system included a PV module, DC -DC converter, MPPT, and a load that is modelled using FLC to get the maximum extracted power. It removes the harmonics and gives the maximum power, and it makes the system robust so that the solar module can give the maximum power. The outcomes clearly show that FLC is favorable in harsh weather conditions and also gives the performance better than the conventional methods generally used in PV modules. The simulation models give the results in terms of irradiance, temperature, and load variability under steady state conditions after removing the power oscillations.

articleTitle: Phase Analysis for a Three-Layer Focusing Metasurface with Impedance Boundary Conditions
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a method to theoretically analyze the phase shift limit of focusing metasurface. Particularly, impedance boundaries are used instead of lens units with multiple metal patterns for the maximum phase shift limit of the three-layer metal and double-layer dielectric structure. It is found that the phase is limited as no more than 400° by changing the capacitance value of the parallel equivalent circuit of capacitors and inductors. Based on this three-layer structure, a focusing lens with dimension of 480 mm×480 mm×7.5 mm (≈ 7.8λ×7.8λ×0.1225λ) operating at 4.9 GHz is proposed. The lens, consisting of 1600 units arranged in a 40×40 arrangement, can focus a vertically incident plane wave at a position z = 205 ~ 279 mm. The peak of the electric field along the oz-axis is 8 times higher than without it, revealing the exceptional focusing performance of the lens.

articleTitle: Evaluation Trends and Development In Integrated Circuit Parasitic Extraction
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: With the advancement in circuit performance (higher speeds) and density increase (Moore’s law) in deep sub micrometer (DSM) designs, interconnect parasitic effects become more and more important. Accurate parasitic extraction during IC design is mostly required as feature sizes shrink, process technologies become more complex, and the design margin gets smaller. This paper looks at the current state and trends of parasitic extraction for resistance and capacitance. Evaluation trends along with case study of machine learning based parasitic extraction method is presented in this paper and a fairly comprehensive list of references is provided.

articleTitle: Modular STATCOM for Unbalanced Load
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In the current energy scenario, power quality and transmission network voltage profile maintenance are challenging. The popular FACTS device STATCOM lacks dynamic performance under severe faults and unbalanced nonlinear loads because it is based on a convectional voltage source converter. Recent developments in the M-STATCOM are helping to overcome this issue, but they also call for more sophisticated control mechanisms to address the issue. Considering this, a modular STATCOM is suggested for improving power quality under unbalanced load, mitigating voltage sag, and compensating reactive power. An optimization method known as "Ant Colony Optimization" enhances the performance of the converter. It does this by lowering the percentage of total harmonic distortion (THD) from 24.74% to 4.50%, mitigating voltage sag from 80% to 2.8%. Through MATLAB/SIMULINK software simulation, the performance and effectiveness of the suggested MMC STATCOM under unbalanced load are verified.

articleTitle: Solar-Powered Electric Vehicle Battery Charging: Integrating LT8490 for Sustainable and Efficient Energy Transfer in the Pursuit of a Green Transportation Future
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The project Solar-Based EV Battery Charging using Solar Panel, LT8490, and Battery presents a sustainable solution for electric vehicle (EV) charging infrastructure. Leveraging solar energy, the system integrates a solar panel and the LT8490 for efficient power management during charging. The solar panel acts as a renewable energy source, capturing sunlight and converting it into electrical power. The LT8490, a key component in this system, plays a crucial role in managing power flow, ensuring optimal charging efficiency, and safeguarding the EV battery against overvoltage and other potential issues. The LT8490 optimizes energy transfer from the solar panel to the electric vehicle battery, ensuring a safe and environmentally friendly process. This innovative approach not only reduces the environmental impact associated with conventional charging methods but also promotes energy independence.

articleTitle: Cipher Care : Multi-Authentication Video Steganography Powered by CNNs
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In the age of digital communication and safeguarding data, the imperative to discreetly hide confidential information in plain view has grown significantly crucial. This paper, titled "Cipher care: Multi-Authentication Video Steganography Powered by CNNs" addresses this need by developing a novel approach to hide one video within another, secured by dual authentication mechanisms. The system's process is when a user submits a 'cover video' and a 'hide video,' accompanied by a unique password and an authentication audio clip. The innovation lies in the use of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) to seamlessly embed the hide video within the cover video, leveraging CNNs' understanding of spatial relationships. Authentication hinges on the user password and the provided audio clip, both of which are vital for successful hidden video recovery. Results demonstrate Cipher Care's exceptional performance with an average PSNR of 64.01 dB, surpassing traditional steganography methods.

articleTitle: An Automated Helmet Detection for Bike Power Start Control using Yolov8
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: YOLO (You Only Look Once) Version 8 is an advanced and highly efficient object detection algorithm that offers real-time, single-pass object detection with exceptional speed and accuracy. This submitted system's design revolves around using the YOLOv8 model for helmet detection to control the bike's ignition switch by relay switch. In this setup, the bike's engine can only be started when the camera detects the presence of a helmet on the rider. Otherwise, It will alert by an alarm. This promising system aims to curtail motorcycle accident-related fatalities by enforcing the compulsory use of helmets, thus encouraging responsible and safer riding habits. The YOLOv8 model for helmet detection interfaces with Raspberry Pi to oversee and control all its functionalities and ensure that the relay switch allows the current into the bike power circuit when the camera verifies the presence of a helmet.

articleTitle: Enhancing Computer Vision Through Transformational Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The mouse is the most important invention in Human-Computer Interaction (HCI). Computer vision has evolved dramatically, allowing computers to recognize people utilizing basic CV techniques. This method is frequently used in a variety of everyday applications, such as the recognition of faces, color identification, and self-driving vehicles. The objective of this research model is to develop a model that includes camera-based recognition. To operate the mouse and keyboard, hand gestures are employed. The machine's camera can record the user's hand motions in real-time, and the pointer of the mouse or arrow on the machine's screen is going to react. Another finger and palm action indicates the left and right click-points for performing the operations. Likely, other hand gestures may be utilized to accomplish keyboard functions, such as selecting an alphabet with a finger and swiping a number with four digits to the right or left. The simulated input devices may be utilized online or outwardly, then the one gear required for the model is a camera. This model is implemented in Python programming Language, a programming language that is both versatile and user-friendly. The proposed solution is a low-cost and user-friendly replacement for existing input devices, eliminating the need for a keyboard and an actual mouse. The significance of image recognition in the creation of unique interaction between humans and computer technologies with possibilities for use in the fields of education, healthcare, and amusement is highlighted in this study’s paper.

articleTitle: Digital Image Forgery Detection using Convolutional Neural Network (CNN): A Survey
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Nowadays, there are lots of pictures everywhere because almost everyone has a camera or a smartphone. This has led to a worrying trend: people change images for different reasons. While digital images are powerful tools for information exchange, they are also susceptible to exploitation for political, cultural, economic, and social purposes through the dissemination of falsified information. The widespread availability of sophisticated image editing software has significantly lowered the barriers to image manipulation, making it challenging to detect such forgeries. These manipulated images can have far-reaching consequences, affecting fields such as medical diagnosis, legal judgments, politics, and insurance claims. This paper delves into the realm of forgery detection, a vital domain within machine vision. It comprehensively examines the techniques employed to manipulate digital images and offers a detailed review of existing methodologies for digital image forgery detection.

articleTitle: Extensive Critique on Blending Studies Conducted in Insulating Fluids for Transformer Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Knowing the essential blending techniques covered by the insulating oil blending studies is crucial, as evidenced by the findings presented in them. Mapping the pertinent parameters to the corresponding technique is an important step in blending investigation. This thorough but perceptive evaluation relates the results of problems with the mixing procedure on different insulating fluids. The techniques employed in this context offer not only a preview but also specifics on the chosen blending process, important characteristics, intended usage, standards, unique testing, and software. In general, these data are used as a bundle to create new ideas for combining insulating fluid investigations. Future study will focus on using cutting-edge techniques to increase analysis speed through the use of comprehensive tools. This is relevant to the insulating oils that are used in the Distribution Transformer (DT) and the Power Transformer (PT).

articleTitle: Smart Processing of Exceptional Values in Electrical Networks Using Neuro-Fuzzy Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This research introduces a novel smart meter topology within the context of an integrated PV-Wind hybrid system for DC electric micro-networks. The proposed topology incorporates advanced techniques such as Linear Interpolation, Artificial Neural Network (ANN), and Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Inference System (ANFIS) for identifying and correcting outliers in the collected data. The integration of the smart meter with outlier detection and correction modules enhances the accuracy and reliability of the measurements, contributing to the overall efficiency of the micro-network. Linear Interpolation is employed to estimate and fill in missing data points, ensuring a continuous and consistent dataset. The ANN module is designed to identify outliers by learning patterns from historical data, allowing for real-time anomaly detection. Furthermore, the ANFIS module enhances the system's adaptability by providing a fuzzy logicbased approach to correct outliers, taking into account the dynamic nature of renewable energy sources in the hybrid system. The proposed smart meter topology offers a comprehensive solution for ensuring the integrity of data collected in DC electric micronetworks. By leveraging the synergies of Linear Interpolation, ANN, and ANFIS, the system demonstrates improved robustness against data anomalies, thereby enabling more accurate monitoring, control, and optimization of the PV-Wind hybrid system. This research contributes to the advancement of smart grid technologies, particularly in the realm of renewable energy micro-networks, by addressing the challenges associated with data quality and reliability.

articleTitle: Exploring the Impact of ‘Emotion-Recognition-AI’ on Consumer Trust and Satisfaction
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The goal of this research is to study key factors related to ‘Emotion-Recognition-AI’ that influences consumers' purchase behavior and consumer Trust and Satisfaction. A total of 609 respondents participated using convenience sampling in questionnaire survey and 433 valid responses were found. SMART-PLS software is used to assess the data and build structural equation model. The variables ‘Emotion-Recognition-AI’ type, Emotion Display Format, Product Category, and User Interface Design have a significant impact on Consumer Engagement and Trust and Customer Satisfaction. But, the variable Emotion Feedback Timing do not have much impact on mediating and dependent variables. There may be other external variables that could impact consumer trust and satisfaction. This research aims to contribute to the study of how AI technology can influence consumer behavior and decision-making processes and can be of great help to the marketing pros who want to explore AI tools for marketing strategy.

articleTitle: An Enquiry into the Adoption and Effectiveness of Blockchain Technology in Trade Finance
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This study aims to understand the Blockchain’s effect and impact on trade finance. Blockchain has transformed the financial sector in a big way; all the big companies are moving towards implementing Blockchain in their practices. These implementations have both pros and shortcomings in their work. This paper will help to understand all the problems, valuable insights, and weaknesses with implementing Blockchain in trade finance. This research can give valuable insights into the applications of blockchain technology in trade finance. Primary data was collected through a questionnaire in the form of Google Forms. The responses were collected from Finance Students and people working in the finance domain. The survey focuses on the participant's perception of the application, opportunities and challenges of using blockchain in trade finance. It was prepared after a thorough review of the literature available in the area of blockchain technology and use of it in trade finance. The researcher engaged in discussions with the experts to get some insights about the benefits and limitations of the subject. Using blockchain technology can give transparency, ease operations, increase efficiency, and reduce fraud risk. Blockchain can be used in many domains, including trade finance, Accounting, supply chain, health care, insurance, manufacturing, etc.

articleTitle: Speed Warning System Using Python
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The project addresses the escalating challenges posed by a surge in vehicular traffic, particularly focusing on highway safety issues arising from speed violations. Leveraging Python, the Speed Warning System employs Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) techniques to vigilantly monitor vehicle speeds. Aiming to proactively reduce accidents caused by speeding, the system incorporates a buzzer-driven auditory alert when vehicles surpass prescribed speed limits. Designed with a sophisticated architecture, the system visually communicates speed limits through signage, capturing drivers' attention and promoting compliance. The overarching goal is to enhance road safety by effectively curbing accidents associated with speed breaches, underscoring the project’s strategic role in advancing comprehensive safety measures.

articleTitle: Utilizing Machine Learning to foster employee mental health in modern workplace environment
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This study offers a novel approach to tackling the increasing problem of workplace stress by utilizing machine learning techniques. Professionals in modern work contexts experience heightened levels of stress due to demanding job requirements, technical challenges, and the common expectation of perpetual availability. This work presents a comprehensive stress detection and mitigation method that utilizes advanced machine learning techniques, including image processing and real-time monitoring, to identify indicators of stress and offer personalized treatments. The system comprises several components, encompassing data collection and user interfaces, with the objective of promoting a more salubrious work environment and enhancing employee welfare and efficiency.

articleTitle: A Novel 1-bit Fast and Low Power 19-T Full Adder Circuit at 45 nm Technology Node
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In this work a 1-bit 19T full adder has been designed and proposed, which is fast and highly optimized in terms of power consumption and minimum latency. The proposed circuit have less output capacitance and short-circuit power dissipation which helps in reduction of power consumption. This 1-bit 19T full adder is based on full swing XOR-XNOR and XOR/XNOR gates logic, which offer significant advantages in speed, power consumption, power delay product (PDP), and driving capabilities compared to other full adders now in use. Our designed is based on 45-nm technology and we have simulated it on Cadence virtuoso software. The output results of the simulation confirm that the 1-bit 19T full adder is fast and consumes less power than the existing ones. The unique transistor sizing method is used to optimize the power delay product of the circuit.

articleTitle: Time Frequency Analysis and Deep Feature Extraction for Hand Gesture Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Hand gesture categorization is a crucial field of study for hand gesture-based systems that provide significant advantages in human-computer interaction (HCI). HCI-based systems are coupled with surface electromyography (sEMG) data source to obtain extremely clear and accurate movement information. This paper proposes a deep learning-based method based on sEMG signals for classifying human hand gestures. The sEMG signals are displayed in the form of time–frequency images by applying continuous wavelet transform. Time frequency images are considered as input to convolutional neural network. The pre trained model such as VGG16, AlexNet, and Resnet-18 are utilized for deep feature extraction. And classification of hand gestures using sEMG signal is done with support vector machine classifier (SVM). The experimental results are compared to different findings from the literature and improved classification accuracy of 92.4% for 7 gestures and 93.8% for 6 gestures is achieved.

articleTitle: Mean-Based Approach To Omnidirectional Pathfinding Algorithm Using Single Ultrasonic Sensor For Robotic Car
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Our project centers around creating and practically testing a pathfinding algorithm using a single ultrasonic sensor on a test RC car. The algorithm consists of two phases: normal and intensive detection. This algorithm provides a reliable method for determining an obstacle-free path. The intensive detection method uses a servo motor for a broader field of view, thus creating an omnidirectional composite sensor with just one monodirectional sensor. It reduces the number of potential false positives for the ideal path by a mean-based approach.

articleTitle: Unleashing the Power of Deep Convolutional Neural Networks in a Stacked Ensemble Model for Precise Paediatric Pneumonia Diagnosis from Chest Radiographs
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Pneumonia is a global health concern caused by various pathogens and its most prevalent impact is in Sub-Saharan Asia and South Asia. The Reports indicate that highest mortality is under the age of 5 years. The mortality specially in developing countries is attributed to delayed diagnosis and cost involved in conducting the tests. Chest X-ray has become the preferable diagnosis tool for pneumonia detection. But the doctor patient ratio in developing nations is also of concern. Automated diagnosis to detect the disease will aid in addressing these challenges. Deep learning based automated techniquesto detect pneumonia from Chest X-ray images have become an important advent in the field. However, the accuracy of these techniques is still in the exploration phase. We have proposed a stacked ensemble learning classifier using transfer learning to detect pneumonia. Our designed classified is based on DenseNet201, MobileNetV2 and InceptionResNetV2 pretrained classifiers. The accuracy of the pretrained individual model is 91%, 90% and 90% respectively but our designed stacked classifier is with 94%. The performance gain suggests its promising application in the field.

articleTitle: "Online Assignment Plagiarism Checker with Ocr
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The chapter addresses plagiarism, highlighting its detrimental effects on education and the state of the economy in the country. It draws attention to several types of plagiarism, such as paraphrased writing, keyword searches, and verbatim. One way for detecting plagiarism is to use WordNet for sentence transformation and overlap identification. The paragraph also discusses a plagiarism detector program that lets users upload assignment files, establish login passwords, and compare content with the source web pages. The subject of optical character recognition (OCR) in computer vision is covered in the second section. It talks about how accurately OCR reads printed text and how some scanning faults can make some fields unreadable. The passage illustrates the use of text recognition by major international tech companies such as Apple.

articleTitle: Modeling and Analysis of Actively-Damped DC-DC Boost Converter with Constant Power Load
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Power electronics-based power systems Nowadays are of the Direct Current type and include more than one converter systems rather than a single-converter-type system. The stability of multi-converter power electronic systems is an important issue. Research has been done in this field, and several methods have been proposed to overcome the problem. One of the basic methods is to include the damping to the output LC filter of the converter. In the DC microgrid, point of load (POL) converters regulate their output voltages. These converters behave as constant power loads (CPLs) for the feeder converter which poses the stability issue to the system. In this paper damping methods namely passive damping and active damping has been discussed. Also, the small-signal model of the actively-damped converter with CPL with the eigenvalue plot indicating the reason for instability is presented along with the simulation result in LT-Spice software by incorporating the load current and reference voltage variations.

articleTitle: Enhancing Endometrial Tumor Detection: Early Diagnosis with Advanced Vision Transformer Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Early detection and treatment are key to improving the prognosis of endometrial cancer. However, conventional machine learning approaches have limited capacity to simulate the complex links between histopathological images and their interpretations, making it challenging to achieve accurate results. A vision transformer-based image classification model has been proposed to assist medical professionals in detecting endometrial cancer and improving patient outcomes. This study aims to develop and evaluate a vision transformer-based model for accurately detecting histopathology images of endometrium, and compare its performance against existing fine-tuning methods such as MobilenetV2, Xception, and VGG16. A publicly accessible histopathology imaging dataset of endometrium was used to train and validate the proposed model. The performance of the model was evaluated against state-of-the-art approaches in the field. The validation results showed that the proposed model attained an accuracy of 99.36%, surpassing the performance of existing fine-tuning methods and achieving the state-of-the-art performance in the widely used endometrial cancer benchmark dataset. These findings highlight the potential of vision transformer-based models in accurately detecting histopathology images of endometrium, which could lead to better patient outcomes. This study highlights the potential of this model as a valuable tool for medical professionals in the early detection and treatment of endometrial cancer, ultimately improving patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Battery Management System for Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: the automobile industry has witnessed a notable surge in the use of electric car technologies. The battery is an essential component of electric vehicle technology. The battery stack alone determines the cost of an electric automobile virtually entirely. It is vital to safeguard the battery stacks because of routine maintenance and supervision. The Electronic Control Unit (ECU) and the Battery Management System (BMS) oversee this entire task. An integral part of the BMS's overall operation is cell balancing, which mostly impacts Li-ion batteries. This essay addresses the significance of cell balancing. Putting greater emphasis on preserving cell equilibrium.

articleTitle: Hexagon Shaped Coplanar Antenna for Higher Gain and Directivity
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This research introduces a novel Hexagon-shaped coplanar microstrip patch antenna that stands out for its compact design. Utilizing the co-planar waveguide port (CPW) principle on an FR-4 substrate, this study explores a unique approach. The antenna showcased here boasts an impressive fractional bandwidth of 83.16% across the 4.126GHz to 10GHz frequency range. Through careful geometric adjustments, the antenna's gain and directivity have been significantly improved. Achieving a high gain of 5.66dBi and a maximum directivity of 6.25dBi specifically at 9GHz, this design stands as a notable advancement. Remarkably, this performance comes within a compact size, measuring 28×26×1.6 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>.

articleTitle: Component Traceability, Drive Control of different machines in cylinder block line
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This project presents an extensive industrial automation system focusing on Scanning, Data Acquisition, and Data Visualization. It integrates Cognex DPM scanners across production lines, transitioning from wired to wireless connectivity. VB.NET applications facilitate data acquisition, linking scanners to a central database. It also involves retrieving information from PLC S7-300 devices and Ignition SCADA that comes from IO-Link sensors via TCP/IP or MQTT protocols. A key aspect of the project is the design and implementation of a comprehensive solution for the Drive control system, covering both Variable Frequency Drives (VFD) and Servo drives. This involves creating a MATLAB simulation model for dynamic analysis and developing corresponding Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) ladder logic for real-time control in industrial applications.

articleTitle: Chaotic-PSO Approach For Optimal Power Flow
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Optimal power flow (OPF), which aims to find the safest and most economical operating point while satisfying a variety of constraints, is a significant optimization problem in power systems. In this paper, a novel approach to OPF problem solution with Chaotic Particle Swarm Optimization (CPSO) is presented. Suggested approach improves the algorithm’s capacity to break out of local optima and converge towards global solutions by fusing the chaotic dynamics with the exploration-exploitation powers of Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO). The particle movement becomes unpredictable due to its chaotic character, which enhances the algorithm’s capacity to negotiate difficult solution spaces. In comparison to conventional optimization methods, the research assesses the performance of CPSO-OPF algorithm on benchmark test systems. The suggested method finds nearly optimal solutions for OPF issues, balancing computer efficiency and solution quality, as demonstrated by simulation results. The convergence and robustness of CPSO-OPF render it a valuable tool for resolving complex and large-scale power system problems, hence promoting the development of robust and effective energy management approaches.

articleTitle: Dermatec: Transformative AI-Driven Platform for Comprehensive Skin Disease Monitoring and Dermatologist Recommendations
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Dermatec, a pioneering healthcare research initiative, utilizes advanced machine-learning methods to address chronic dermatological conditions. Integrating robust data preprocessing and employing a state-of-the-art Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), Dermatec achieves precise skin condition analysis. Introducing a novel Siamese neural network for efficient image comparison enables autonomous skin monitoring and assessing recovery. Comparative analysis reveals exceptional outcomes, with the CNN model achieving an impressive 99.8% accuracy, surpassing prior models. This research significantly advances diagnostic accuracy, refines treatment recommendations, and empowers patients. By integrating extensive patient data, Dermatec continually evolves, showcasing the potential to revolutionize dermatology research. Dermatec stands as a beacon of promise, contributing groundbreaking innovations to healthcare and chronic skincare research.

articleTitle: Evaluating Wide Band Gap Semiconductor Hybrid Switches: A Comparative Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In an effort to completely transform the effectiveness and performance of DC-DC converters, this study investigates the revolutionary possibilities of wide bandgap devices (WBG) incorporated into hybrid switches. Although traditional semiconductor paralleling has shown to be an economical means of increasing current capacity, but provide a challenge in high-frequency operations. Examining WBG technologies such as silicon carbide (SiC) and gallium nitride (GaN), this work aims to create WBG based hybrid switches that match the advantages of traditional topologies, allowing for higher frequencies of operation. In order to minimize switching losses, several configurations of hybrid switches based on WBG are explored. The double pulse test is used to examine the switching losses. The obtained results identifies that the SiC/GaN hybrid switch has almost 50% reduced in switching losses at higher currents when compared to SiC/SiC, GaN/GaN switch.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Transceiver for Near- End Communication System using Verilog HDL
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This paper describes a fast and reliable technique for communication between two short-range devices over wired or wireless networks, using a self-designed transmitter and receiver system modules. A good and lossless Device to device communication (D2DC) is crucial in the development of different electronic systems. In the present day, data transmission techniques are inefficient as they require an adequately large amount of time for transmission and reception. This paper presents a simple lossless technique for transmission and reception of data across wired systems or low range wireless systems. The proposed system consumes less power and reduces the amount of time taken in data transmission and acquisition.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis on ChatGPT Reviews
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Sentiment analysis, a critical aspect of natural language processing, involves the identification and interpretation of emotions, opinions, and attitudes expressed in text. This review explores the innovative approach of employing ChatGPT, a prominent language model developed by OpenAI, for sentiment analysis tasks. This study employs the Bag-of-Word (BoW) technique to analyze sentiment. The research will also focus on creating models through machine learning methods. The dataset is obtained from the App Store, specifically targeting reviews related to ChatGPT. Filtering ensures only English reviews are considered, resulting in a dataset of 22,000 reviews. A preprocessing approach is applied for data cleaning before utilizing BoW for feature extraction. Subsequently, the study involves deploying, training, and assessing classifiers. Evaluation metrics are employed to measure classifier precision. Among the four classifiers tested, XGBOOST (XGB) excels when combined with BoW features, showcasing the highest accuracy. In the context of Bag-of-Words, the XGBOOST classifier achieves an 84% accuracy rate in data classification.

articleTitle: Electric Bicycle using Pedal Assist System (PAS)
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The purpose of this paper was to design and build an electric bicycle that incorporates the Pedal Assist System (PAS). The PAS system detects when the rider starts pedaling and immediately kicks in to provide electric assistance, making riding easier and more efficient. Our team utilized a lithium-ion battery and a brush less DC motor to power the PAS system. The bicycle was designed to be easy to ride, energy efficient and sustainable mode of transportation. The PAS system was successfully integrated into the bicycle, and it proved to be highly effective in assisting the rider. Overall, our paper successfully demonstrated that PAS based electric bicycles are a viable alternative to traditional bicycles and gasoline- powered vehicles, with the potential to revolutionize personal transportation.

articleTitle: MobileNet-Powered Deep Learning for Efficient Face Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Facial image analysis and categorization have recently made great strides in computer vision. The current study, explores ways to help computers better recognize faces quickly and accurately, especially for tasks like security and entertainment. Identifying faces, emotions, and identities is crucial in Security and Surveillance, Access Control, user Authentication in Smart Devices, and Emotion Analysis in Human-Computer Interaction. Adopting the MobileNet deep learning model because it requires less memory works efficiently. To make it even more effective at recognizing faces, adjusted its parameters and tested it with two data sets, the CASIA 3D face data set and 105 pins data set. The study using MobileNetV2 achieved a very high accuracy of 98.71% on the CASIA 3D face data set and 99.29% on the 105 pins data set. The experimental results show that MobileNetV2 better understands faces in different situations.

articleTitle: PROP – where learning is made fun
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Writing in air has become a significant research area in image processing and pattern recognition, contributing to automation and improving human-machine interfaces in various applications. Object tracking, a crucial task in Computer Vision, is increasingly popular due to faster computers, high-quality video cameras, and automated video analysis demands. This study provides a comparison of virtual air canvas using OpenCV and Mediapipe and air canvas application using OpenCV and Numpy in python. Further it dwells into usage of Augmented Reality for educational purposes and how if these two if are integrated together will revolutionize teaching and learning

articleTitle: Vehicle Damage Identification using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In this innovative study, a cutting-edge approach harnessing YOLOv8 and ResNet-50 is proposed for an advanced vehicle damage detection system. Integrating damage segmentation and a meticulous repairing management system, this solution aims to revolutionize workshop operations. Through the utilization of sophisticated algorithms, the system accurately identifies and categorizes vehicular damages, facilitating precise and efficient repair strategies. Moreover, this comprehensive system incorporates an intelligent airbag recommendation feature, optimizing safety measures based on the detected damages. The integration of an accident dashboard further enhances the system's functionality, providing real-time insights into accident patterns and trends. This holistic approach not only streamlines workshop workflows but also prioritizes safety and precision in vehicular repair processes, marking a significant advancement in vehicle damage detection technology.

articleTitle: Compressed Deep Learning Model For Human Activity Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Researchers are becoming more interested in Human Activity Recognition (HAR) because wide varity application of HAR.Due to the fact that wearable sensors such as accelerometers and gyroscopes may give time-series data for the analysis of human behavior, there has been a spike in interest in Human Activity Recognition (HAR). Effective HAR necessitates the extraction of critical temporal aspects from the data. Conventional methods are time-consuming, frequently necessitate expert knowledge, and involve extensive feature engineering and data processing. A breakthrough in automated feature detection was made possible by a unique Deep Neural Network that combined Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN). On the WISDM dataset, this model’s accuracy was 99.74 percent. Its huge size, however, makes integration onto microcontrollers difficult. Techniques like quantization and pruning are used to address this, which makes these models appropriate for edge devices.

articleTitle: ATS: Auto Text Summarization using Natural Language Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Automatic Text Summarization (ATS) is a crucial task in Natural Language Processing (NLP), seeking to distill critical information from voluminous textual data. This review provides a concise overview of extractive and abstractive summarization techniques. We explore the methodology used in various papers and extractive features usually implemented in building models like text summarization. Literature review, process, and comparative results are discussed, offering analysis of prominent approaches. This review is a quick reference for researchers and practitioners navigating the evolving landscape of auto-text summarization.

articleTitle: Web Design Dilemma: A Comprehensive Guide to Adaptive and Responsive Design
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This study delves into the need for a robust web design methodology that can keep up with the ever-changing world of web design. The web design needs to be responsive and adapt to changing environment. A deep analysis is performed about different web design method and their individual strengths and weaknesses. The study takes into its consideration the user experience, development complexities faced by developer and adaptability of website to various devices, thus shaping insights into the factors shaping the methodologies. This study finds out that there is no one-size-fits-all strategy in web design. Each method provides its own benefit, so the project requirements play the vital role to select the best approach using the methods benefits.

articleTitle: Combination of Artificial Intelligence Techniques to Predict Cardiovascular Disease
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The human body's most important organ is the heart. Cardiovascular illness is a catch-all phrase for a variety of disorders that affect your heart. The study of algorithms and statistical models used by computer systems to carry out certain tasks without clear instructions and instead relying on patterns and deduction is known as machine learning (ML). Different algorithms can forecast cardiac disease. A crucial criterion for evaluating an algorithm is accuracy. In this article, a combination method based on naive bayes and random forest was suggested. Calculated parameters include accuracy, classification error, F-measure, recall, and precision. The hybrid algorithm that has been suggested has a 92% accuracy rate.

articleTitle: Artificial Neural Network for short-term load forecasting: An evaluation based on Chhattisgarh State
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Load forecasting is a technique of prediction of future occasion, final occasion, final results or trend of load demand based to on historical and probabilistic data. Short term load forecasting has a significant effect at the efficiency of operation. In short term load forecasting, the goal is to estimate the load for the following half an hour up to the next two weeks. In this study artificial neural network (ANN) approach is presented for load forecasting particularly for Chhattisgarh State. A prediction of very next day is shown with different parameters in order to count those parameters which perform well and are able to provide the best results in prediction. The ANN model is trained using an input dataset which consists of previous year data along with a day before data of same date of predicted load as two different features of input dataset. These features further involve both generation and load demand in it It covers the timeframe from 1 JAN 2022 to 30 NOV 2023 for both training and testing method. After training and testing of model, the result gets evaluated through statistics matrices such as MAPE (mean absolute percentage error) and MAE (mean absolute error) in the end, ensuring accuracy and fitness of the model.

articleTitle: Automated API Docs Generator using Generative AI
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Our study provides an improvement on the creation of Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) usage documentation using the efficiency and power of Generative AI. APIs play an important role in software integration and software maintenance but the process of API documentation creation has been traditional and did not evolve with time, this paper employs Generative AI to enhance the accuracy, speed, and scale of API documentation generation. The automated API documentation generator is created using natural language processing applied through a large language model (TinyPixel/Llama-2-7B-bf16-sharded model). Training data was created by applying web scraping on various large tech companies' documentation web pages to get a good quality and industry-standard documentation dataset. It was further diversified and increased using the GPT model to handle a wide range of API scenarios. The fine-tuning greatly enhanced the TinyPixel/Llama-2-7B-bf16-sharded model's efficiency and quality of output which is proven by the reduced response time and the accuracy of documentation generated. Our study's comparative study confirms the effectiveness of the approach used. Our study's conclusion offers a comprehensive approach that should improve software development processes and pave the way for additional developments in API documentation.

articleTitle: LAWTRIX: NLP Powered Legal Revolution
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In an era of digital transformation, LAWTRIX emerges as a pioneering platform set to revolutionize the legal services landscape in India. With a mission to bridge the space between legal service providers and citizens,LAWTRIX introduces an innovative incentives-based design. The core objectives and features of LAWTRIX, encompasses the onboarding of diverse legal service providers, legal to normal text translation, and a LinkedIn-like interface for seamless networking and collaboration. The legal services market in India presents unique challenges, and Lawtrix is strategically positioned to address them. By providing a user-friendly and intuitive interface, LAWTRIX promises to simplify the complex world of legal services for both providers and users. Central to its design is an incentives-based model that incentivizes active participation, creating a vibrant and engaged community. The integration of legal to normal text translation using NLP is a testament to LAWTRIX’s commitment to effective communication, ensuring that the legal professionals and citizens can engage meaningfully. The onboarding process for the legal service providers, including Advocates, Notaries, Arbitrators, Mediators and other legal services, is meticulously detailed, outlining the verification and credentialing procedures. With a LinkedIn-like interface, LAWTRIX empowers legal professionals to network, collaborate, and expand their horizons within the legal community.

articleTitle: The Signal Processing for K-Band Wind Radar Based on Gauss Cost Function Method
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel signal processing method to extract the wind velocity at one altitude in the k-band wind radar based on the Gauss cost function (GCF). Traditional methods only consider the spatial continuity of turbulence, leading to significant fluctuations in the calculated wind velocity when strong clutter interference is present in the spectrum. Therefore, we consider the temporal continuity of turbulence, when the frequency offset of the clutter significantly deviates from the previous frequency, the Gauss function is used to reshape the current spectrum and amplify the turbulence signal interfered with clutter. Then, using the cost function to estimate the wind velocity at each moment and calculate the parameters required for the Gauss function. The GCF algorithm can effectively improve the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) by 2 dB and increase radar detection accuracy by 10%.

articleTitle: Control of Two-Wheel Self-Balancing Robot: LQR and MPC Performance Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This paper presents the design and comparative analysis of Linear Quadratic Control and Model Predictive Control strategies for a two-wheel self-balancing robot. A detailed mathematical model of the two-wheel self-balancing is provided. After that, the Linear Quadratic Regulator and Model Predictive Control law are designed. In Order to compare the performances of both the controllers, various performance indices such as settling time and peak overshoot value are evaluated. The robustness of these methods is tested against impulse and sinusoidal disturbance. The control signals from linear quadratic regulator and model predictive controllers are also examined. The simulation results are obtained using MATLAB wherein it is observed that model predictive control performed better in both tracing the set points and generating minimal control signal.

articleTitle: Recommendation System for Surplus Food Management using Location based and Collaborative Filtering Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In various industries, recommendation systems are playing an increasingly important role in delivering improved services and customer experiences. In this study, a thorough overview of the suggested system and explanation of the techniques used is offered. Two recommendation systems are built into the Food Surplus App, the first one is a customised recommendation system built on the collaborative filtering mechanism. The Single Value Decomposition Algorithm is used to generate suggestions after computing the cosine similarity to get the similarity measure. The top 5 results and the user's prior history are used to present the results. The second system employs the K-means clustering technique to develop a location-based recommendation system. The clusters map the food item IDs of the restaurants to that location's availability.
